中文译文: 我不知道还能说什么，所以停了下来，艰难地喘着气。

英文原文: After a moment, I realize the wolf is smiling at me, and it takes me a moment to calm down from my Hollywood movie pep talk.
中文译文: 过了一会儿，我才从自己好莱坞式的鼓舞中冷静下来，我注意到狼正在对我微笑。

英文原文: "What?"
中文译文: “怎么了？”

英文原文: "I am going to go out there, [mc], there's no doubt about that. I just...I was just having a moment. I was trying to be more honest with you, but thank you."
中文译文: “我会过去的，[mc]，这点毫无疑问。我只是...只是一时失了神。我之前是在试着对你更坦诚一些，不过还是谢谢你。”

英文原文: I frown.
中文译文: 我皱着眉。

英文原文: "Well, you sure picked a hell of a moment to have it."
中文译文: “好吧，你还真是选了个好时机。”

英文原文: "I know...I've just been having a terrible time after yesterday, is all. I needed to apologize to you."
中文译文: “我知道...昨天之后，我过得很糟糕，仅此而已。 我需要向你道歉。”

英文原文: I deflate a little, but there's some relief there too, seeing Amicus somewhat back to his old self.
中文译文: 我有点泄气，不过看到Amicus多少恢复了一些，心中便也松了口气。

英文原文: "I...well...I forgive you, but this is a lot bigger than us right now."
中文译文: “我...嗯...我原谅你，不过现在还有比我们重要得多的事。”

英文原文: "I know it is, and what I'm feeling is a lot bigger than us as well."
中文译文: “我知道，而且我现在的感受也远不止我们而已。”

英文原文: The wolf sets a paw on my shoulder.
中文译文: 狼将爪子放在我的肩上。

英文原文: "But I'm honest about what I said; I'm sorry, and I will never do anything involving you without your consultation again...and I will take your cultural differences into better consideration in the future."
中文译文: “不过我说的都是实话。对不起，我再也不会瞒着你，做任何会涉及到你的事情了...还有，今后我会更好地考虑你们的文化差异。”

英文原文: I look up at Amicus, at his earnest face, and I find myself hugging him, and he hugs back tightly.
中文译文: 我抬头看着Amicus，看着他真诚的表情，然后不自觉地抱住了他，他也紧紧拥抱住我。

英文原文: "We still need to talk about things, but we can do that later. You need to kick Cassius's ass first."
中文译文: “我们仍然需要谈谈这些，但可以放在以后。首先，你要让Cassius好看。”

英文原文: "I know."
中文译文: “我知道。”

英文原文: Amicus pulls back, both paws on my shoulders now.
中文译文: Amicus拉远身子，现在两只爪子都放在了我的肩上。

英文原文: "And I will."
中文译文: “还有我会的。”

英文原文: There's a gentle clearing of a throat behind us, and we both look back to see Neferu casually lounging in the doorway.
中文译文: 身后传来了轻轻的，清喉咙的声音。我们闻声望去，Neferu漫不经心，懒洋洋地站在门口。

英文原文: "If you're finished, the trial begins in thirty minutes."
中文译文: “比赛将于三十分钟后开始，如果你们谈完了的话。”

英文原文: Immediately, Amicus scowls at the sight of the jackal, but he nods.
中文译文: Amicus看到胡狼的同时，立刻就露出了怒容，不过他点了点头。

英文原文: "I'd better be going then."
中文译文: “那我该出发了。”

英文原文: "So you're feeling better now?"
中文译文: “所以你现在感觉好些了吗？”

英文原文: "Much better, thanks to you!"
中文译文: “好多了，多亏有你。”

英文原文: I smile as I feel a wave of relief, even though this is just like Amicus to be so easily cheered up.
中文译文: 我感到一阵宽慰，露出了微笑，尽管Amicus就是这么容易振作起来。

英文原文: I allow the wolf to pull me toward the door.
中文译文: 我任由狼拉着我走到门口。

英文原文: Neferu moves out of the way as we exit the stifling meditation room.
中文译文: Neferu让开了路，我们走出了这令人窒息的冥想室。

英文原文: "Alright, I'm on my way to a shower."
中文译文: “好了，我要先去洗个澡。”

英文原文: "I'll be watching...the rhetoric thing, I mean."
中文译文: “我会去看的...我说的是修辞比赛。”

英文原文: "Heh, I'll look for you, and...we'll talk after this?"
中文译文: “哈哈，我会找你的，然后...之后我们再谈？”

英文原文: "Yeah, we'll talk after you're emperor."
中文译文: “嗯，等你当上皇帝我们再谈。”

英文原文: "Alright."
中文译文: “好的。”

英文原文: Amicus leans in to kiss me on the lips, then pauses before planting it on my cheek instead.
中文译文: Amicus俯下身来吻我的嘴唇，然后中途停了下来，亲在我的脸颊上。

英文原文: With that, he winks, then turns and dashes up the hall, running at a full sprint.
中文译文: 亲完，他眨了眨眼，然后转身在走廊上冲刺起来，全速奔跑。

英文原文: I hear a soft chuckle behind me.
中文译文: 我听到身后传来咯咯的笑声。

英文原文: "Well, that went rather well. I didn't think that would be half as easy."
中文译文: “哎呀，进展得相当顺利。连我预想中的一半困难都没有。”

英文原文: I glance back at the jackal as he basically reveals he's been planning this all along.
中文译文: 我瞥了一眼身后的胡狼，他基本上已经透露了这是他计划好的。

英文原文: I guess it was obvious.
中文译文: 我想这也很确实很明显。

英文原文: "Shall we head to the throne room? They'll be wanting us sitting down early so they can film us. The whole things is a dreary spectacle, after all."
中文译文: “我们去王座厅好吗？他们希望我们早些入座，好拍摄我们的镜头。毕竟，这会是一场沉闷的表演。”

英文原文: "Alright."
中文译文: “好的。”

英文原文: With that, I follow the jackal toward the throne room, hoping that what I'd said to Amicus is enough to get him in the right head space to help him win.
中文译文: 说完，我跟着胡狼走向王座厅。希望我对Amicus说的话足以让他的头脑清醒过来，帮助他获胜。

英文原文: In just a few hours, I'll know if I'll be leaving soon...or staying for a long, long time.
中文译文: 再过几个小时，就知道我是可以很快离开...还是要再待很长，很长时间了。

英文原文: Either way, I'm just glad that this happened.
中文译文: 不论是哪种，我都会坦然接受的。

英文原文: I follow Neferu to the throne room, the cavernous space just as empty as it was during the first trial.
中文译文: 我跟着Neferu来到了王座厅，那个洞穴似的空间同第一场比赛时一样空旷。

英文原文: Like the first trial though, a few of the palace regulars are sitting on the benches; Virginia on the left side of the room, while Alex sits on the right.
中文译文: 一样的还有坐在长凳上的，皇宫里的老面孔：Virginia坐在房间左侧，Alex坐在右侧。

英文原文: The cat is sat alone, looking tiny compared to the rest of the room, his tail curled neatly under his paws in his lap.
中文译文: 那只猫独自坐着，和房间里的其他狼相比显得很瘦小，他的尾巴整齐地旋绕在大腿上的爪子下面。

英文原文: He smiles when he sees me, and I make as if to go sit next to him...but that's when the jackal grabs my hand.
中文译文: 看到我后他笑了，我正准备坐在他的旁边...不过胡狼抓住了我的手腕。

英文原文: I pause, and I see Alex's own inquisitive look before I turn to Neferu.
中文译文: 我愣了一下，在我转向Neferu之前，我看到了Alex好奇的样子。

英文原文: "What?"
中文译文: “怎么了？”

英文原文: "Why don't we give Virginia some company?"
中文译文: “我们为什么不去陪伴一下Virginia呢？”

英文原文: The jackal smiles at me gently, one of his ears flicking in the direction of the she-wolf.
中文译文: 胡狼对我轻轻微笑着，他的一只耳朵朝着母狼的方向抖了抖。

英文原文: "Um, you can. I was gonna go sit with Alex."
中文译文: “呃，你去就可以了。我想和Alex坐一起。”

英文原文: Neferu's expression doesn't change, but he doesn't let go either, and his voice takes on a gentle, but ominous tone, making me feel a little uncomfortable.
中文译文: Neferu的表情没有变化，同样也没有松口。他的语气听起来很平静，但又不详，这让我感觉有些不自在。

英文原文: "Depending on how this trial goes, we may have some business to take care of before it officially ends. It would be best if you are close to me."
中文译文: “根据比赛的走向，我们可能要在正式结束之前处理一些事情。你最好离我近一些。”

英文原文: It's then that I realize what he's getting at.
中文译文: 我明白他在说什么了。

英文原文: Although I don't know what the process of becoming Neferu's "pet" is, I imagine it involves some sort of official business, like signing something.
中文译文: 虽然不知道成为Neferu的"宠物"需要什么流程，但我猜这涉及到某种公务，比如签署一些东西。

英文原文: So, I give Alex a little frown and shrug, gesturing at the jackal.
中文译文: 于是，我朝Alex微微皱了下眉，耸了耸肩，用手示意了一下胡狼。

英文原文: The cat continues to look confused as I turn away and follow Neferu to the benches on the other side of the room.
中文译文: 那只猫看起来依然很困惑，我跟随Neferu走到了房间另一侧的长凳处。

英文原文: "Neferu."
中文译文: “Neferu。”

英文原文: Virginia sits daintily on the bench, one leg elegantly crossed over the other as she holds up a paw, which the jackal kisses.
中文译文: Virginia讲究地坐在长凳上，两条腿优雅地并在一起。她举起一只爪子，胡狼在了上面亲了一下。

英文原文: "Good day to you, Virginia."
中文译文: “日安，Virginia。”

英文原文: Even though I try to stay behind Neferu, Virginia peers around the Jackal's muscular side to stare straight at me.
中文译文: 尽管我试图躲在Neferu身后，Virginia还是将视线越过了Neferu肌肉发达的身体，端详着我。

英文原文: "I see that you've brought a guest."
中文译文: “我看到你带了一位客人来。”

英文原文: She holds out her paw again, and it takes me a moment to realize that I should kiss it.
中文译文: 她又把爪子伸了出来，我楞了一下，才意识到我应该去亲它。

英文原文: I did start that trend after all.
中文译文: 毕竟这个趋势是我先开始的。

英文原文: "Indeed. Amicus requested I keep him company during the trial."
中文译文: “的确。Amicus请求我在比赛期间陪伴着他。”

英文原文: As I come up from the paw-kissing, I see Virginia frowning.
中文译文: 我亲完爪子抬起头时，看到Virginia皱着眉。

英文原文: "My brother shouldn't be burdening you with a silly chore like that. The pet is capable of staying in his room, I imagine."
中文译文: “我哥哥不该用这么用这么可笑的任务来麻烦你的。我想，宠物可以留在他的房间里。”

英文原文: "It was a mutual agreement. Besides, he is rather good company once you get to know him."
中文译文: “这是我们彼此之间的约定。而且，在了解过他后，他会是一位很好的伙伴。”

英文原文: "Oh really? It seems our little simian is full of surprises."
中文译文: “哦，真的吗？看来我们小小的猿类充满了惊喜。”

英文原文: The she-wolf looks pointedly at me, and I don't have much time to wonder what she's talking about before Neferu is sitting down next to her, pulling me to his side to sit next to him.
中文译文: 母狼用尖锐的目光盯着我，我还没来得及思考她说的是什么意思，Neferu已经坐在了她旁边，然后把我拉过去坐在了他旁边。

英文原文: "That would be an accurate observation."
中文译文: “那是精确观察的结果。”

英文原文: There's a momentary pause before I see Virginia lean forward a bit out of the corner of my eye.
中文译文: 对话短暂中断了一下，我用眼角看到Virginia朝前探了探身子。

英文原文: When she speaks again, her voice is lowered.
中文译文: 然后她压低声音，又开始说话了。

英文原文: "So the rumors are true?"
中文译文: “所以谣言是真的？”

英文原文: There's another pause, this time from Neferu.
中文译文: 又是一个中断，这次是因为Neferu。

英文原文: "I don't believe I'm in a position to speculate on that. It is not my place to involve myself in wolven politics."
中文译文: “我不认为我有资格对此加以推测。我无权干涉沃尔文的政治。”

英文原文: Virginia laughs softly, one that sounds completely fake.
中文译文: Virginia轻轻地笑了，笑声听起来是完全虚假的。

英文原文: "I'm not a fool, Neferu. I may enjoy your suave tactics, but I'd rather you not use them against me."
中文译文: “我不是傻瓜，Neferu。也许我喜欢你的圆滑手段，但我希望你不要用它们来对付我。”

英文原文: "I would not dream of such a thing, Virginia."
中文译文: “我做梦也不会的，Virginia。”

英文原文: "Surely."
中文译文: “想必也是。”

英文原文: Virginia shifts again and now I know for sure that she's looking directly at me.
中文译文: Virginia又换了个姿势，现在我确信她正直勾勾地盯着我看。

英文原文: "So...I suppose he understands what we're saying, then?"
中文译文: “那么...我想他听得懂我们在说什么，是吗？”

英文原文: "Well, he is sapient, and he does possess a lingua."
中文译文: “自然，他是一个智慧生物，而且他拥有Lingua。”

英文原文: "I mean, he {i}understands{/i} us."
中文译文: “我的意思是，他能够{i}理解{/i}我们。”

英文原文: Virginia puts even more emphasis on the word.
中文译文: Virginia着重强调了一下这个词。

英文原文: I see Neferu looking at the floor, still smiling, though his paws seem to clasp each other a bit tighter than usual.
中文译文: Neferu望着地板，依然微笑着，不过他的爪子似乎比平时攥得更紧了。

英文原文: "You'd know better than I, being a wolf. Our children are as intelligent as ourselves, so I'm used to such an idea."
中文译文: “作为一个狼，你应该比我更了解才对。我们的Children与我们有相同的智力水平，所以我早就习以为常了。”

英文原文: "Don't feign ignorance, Neferu. You've been around him far more than I have. It's a simple question, and one that you should answer honestly, otherwise am I to assume that you've brought a little spy to our conversation?"
中文译文: “不要假装无知，Neferu。你在他身边的时间比我长得多。这只是一个简单的问题，而你应该如实地回答，否则我是否应该认为你为我们的谈话带来了一个小间谍？”

英文原文: Although the words seem harsh and dangerous, Virginia's tone is light, and Neferu just laughs.
中文译文: 虽然这些词似乎很尖锐，也很危险，但Virginia的语气却很轻松，而Neferu只是笑了笑。

英文原文: "You accuse me of deception, yet we both know you've already figured out the answer. Why do {i}you{/i} feign ignorance?"
中文译文: “你指责我在隐瞒，但你我都清楚，你已经知道答案了。{i}你{/i}又为什么假装无知？”

英文原文: The wolf fans herself with an air of nonchalance.
中文译文: 狼若无其事地扇着扇子。

英文原文: "It's the best weapon in discourse...and it is easy to feign stupidity, at least for me. It is expected on my part."
中文译文: “这是谈话中最好的武器...而且要装傻也很容易，至少就我而言。这正是我所期望的。”

英文原文: "And why would you say something like that?"
中文译文: “你为什么会说这样的话呢？”

英文原文: "I have a vagina, Neferu."
中文译文: “我有阴道，Neferu。”

英文原文: It takes me moment to absorb what Virginia just said, but Neferu's already chuckling with what's probably the first genuine laugh of the conversation.
中文译文: 我花了些时间才明白Virginia刚才的话是什么意思，而Neferu已经轻声笑了出来，这应该是谈话中第一次真正的笑声。

英文原文: I see Alex look over at us again, and this time it looks like his eyes are narrowed a bit.
中文译文: 我看到Alex又望了过来，这次他似乎眯着眼睛。

英文原文: It takes the jackal a few seconds to get himself under control again as Virginia continues to wave her fan, looking rather pleased with herself.
中文译文: 胡狼花了好几秒才再次控制住了自己，Virginia继续挥舞着扇子，看起来对这个反应相当满意。

英文原文: "Sorry, I'm not used to bluntness here."
中文译文: “不好意思，我还没有习惯这里的直率。”

英文原文: "It's not impossible for us to be blunt on this moon, Neferu, especially amongst friends."
中文译文: “在这个卫星上，直言不讳并非是不可能的，Neferu，尤其是朋友之间。”

英文原文: I notice the wolf is looking at me again, and once again, I look down.
中文译文: 我注意到狼又在看我了，我又低下头。

英文原文: "Anyway, it seems we made quite the mistake in overlooking Simia. I may have to do a little research of my own in the archives. Amicus clearly knew something that we did not."
中文译文: “总之，我们忽略了希米安似乎是个相当的失误，我也许应该独自去资料室调查一下。Amicus显然知道一些我们不了解的事情。”

英文原文: Research?
中文译文: 调查？

英文原文: I feel my stomach drop.
中文译文: 我感觉我的胃沉了一下。

英文原文: Although Amicus had assured me of things, I don't even know if I really look like a Simian.
中文译文: 虽然Amicus很自信地向我保证过，但我甚至不知道自己是否真的像一个希米安。

英文原文: All it might take is a picture to know that I'm not actually from Simia.
中文译文: 也许只要一张照片，就能揭穿我并不是希米安了。

英文原文: I try to put that thought out of my mind for now as the doors suddenly open and Cato walks in, making his way quickly to the throne.
中文译文: 突然，门打开了。Cato走了进来，迅速朝着王座而去，我试图暂时把这个想法从脑海中抹去。

英文原文: Virginia finally takes her eyes off of me, and I can only hope that she's not gonna follow through on her research plans.
中文译文: Virginia终于把她的目光从我身上移开了，我只能祈祷她不会坚持她的调查计划。

英文原文: The throne room is so quiet that I hear the old wolf grunt as he makes his way up the stairs before turning to face us.
中文译文: 王座厅是如此的安静，以至于我能听到老狼走上台阶时发出的哼声。然后，他转身朝向我们。

英文原文: After a few seconds, he sits down, his heavy, muscular body slouched a bit in his seat, gazing out at us through his visor.
中文译文: 几秒钟后，他坐了下来。他沉重的，肌肉发达的身体有些懒散地坐在座位上，隔着他的面甲向外凝视着我们。

英文原文: A few more moments pass in silence, and just as I'm wondering if the trial is going to begin, I hear a soft, mechanical whirring sound as the panel in the ceiling opens up.
中文译文: 几分钟的沉默过去了，就在我想着比赛还要不要开始的时候，天花板上传来了镶板打开的声音，还有机械轻微的嗡嗡声。

英文原文: A dozen camera drones drift down lazily, fanning out in the air to position themselves in various locations throughout the room.
中文译文: 十几架摄像无人机晃悠悠地落了下来，在空中散开，分布在房间各处。

英文原文: One of them floats towards us and hovers just above our heads, the lens seeming to focus on my face.
中文译文: 其中一架飘了过来，在我们头顶上方盘旋着，镜头似乎聚焦在我的脸上。

英文原文: I drop my head again, the action having become second-nature since I landed on this moon.
中文译文: 我再一次低下了头，自从来到这个卫星后，这似乎已经成为一种习惯了。

英文原文: Neferu nudges me though.
中文译文: 不过，Neferu用胳膊肘轻轻推了我一下。

英文原文: "Come now. Amicus brought you here to be seen."
中文译文: “来吧。Amicus把你带到这儿来是给大家看的。”

英文原文: His tone is light as always, but I sense he's not saying that just to tease me.
中文译文: 他的语气一如既往地轻松，但我觉得他这么说并不是为了取笑我。

英文原文: We're all playing a role here, and my role is to make Amicus look good, to show off to the triumvirates that he went to great lengths to obtain an exotic, fascinating, alien pet.
中文译文: 我们都在其中扮演着一个角色，而我的角色就是让Amicus看起来很有面子，向三人执政团炫耀他不竭余力得来的奇异、迷人的外星宠物。

英文原文: I might not like it, but that doesn't matter right now, so I lift my head.
中文译文: 我也许不喜欢，但这和现在没有关系。于是，我抬起了头。

英文原文: Instead of the dumb, vacant gaze I'd been using this past month, I go with a completely straight face.
中文译文: 我没有像上个月那样，眼神呆滞、空洞，而是满脸的庄重。

英文原文: "Watch the red light on the top of the drone. When it turns green, know that you are being broadcast."
中文译文: “留意无人机顶部的红灯。当它变绿时，就是你正在被播出。”

英文原文: "The second trial will begin in ten seconds."
中文译文: “第二场选拔赛将于十秒后开始。”

英文原文: With that, the lights slowly dim and everything goes completely silent.
中文译文: 同时，光线渐渐暗了下来，周围的一切都陷入了完全的寂静中。

英文原文: I just sit there, looking toward the throne, Cato sitting as motionless as an ancient Roman sculpture.
中文译文: 我坐在那里，望着王座，Cato像一尊古罗马雕像一样纹丝不动地坐在上面。

英文原文: Then the doors open, and we all look over, including the cameras.
中文译文: 接着，门开了，所有人的目光都被吸引了过去，包括摄像机。

英文原文: In walk Amicus and Cassius, side-by-side.
中文译文: Amicus和Cassius并排走了进来。

英文原文: They must have been waiting out there next to each other, just like Alex and I had been before the second trial.
中文译文: 他们一定是在外边等待着，就像之前的我和Alex那样。

英文原文: I have to wonder what that must have been like.
中文译文: 我不由地想知道那是什么样子。

英文原文: Without a word, the two of them walk up the broad, carpeted aisle, in sync with each other.
中文译文: 他们两个一言不发地走在铺着地毯的宽阔过道上，步调一致。

英文原文: I stare intently at Amicus as he passes, just in case he looks at me and I can give him an encouraging smile.
中文译文: Amicus经过了我的身旁，我目不转睛地盯着他。为了他看向我时，我可以报以一个鼓励的微笑。

英文原文: He looks straight ahead though, a more serious expression on his face than I've ever seen.
中文译文: 不过他始终目视着前方，他脸上是我前所未见的严肃表情。

英文原文: Everything stays quiet, the only sound being the muffled shuffling of their padded feet and claws on the carpet.
中文译文: 一切都保持着寂静，唯一能听到的，就是他们脚上的肉垫和爪子在地毯上拖行的模糊声音。

英文原文: Once they reach the foot of the stairs, they come to a stop before they both bow deeply to Cato.
中文译文: 在抵达楼梯脚后，他们停了下来，并深深地向Cato鞠躬。

英文原文: This lasts a few seconds before Cato finally shifts again, breaking the illusion that he was made out of stone.
中文译文: 这持续了几秒钟，直到Cato终于挪动了一下，打破了他是石头制品的假象。

英文原文: "Very good. You may proceed."
中文译文: “非常好，你们可以继续了。”

英文原文: With that, the two brothers straighten back up before walking up the steps, splitting off to stand to either side of the acting emperor.
中文译文: 说完，两兄弟挺直了腰板，走上台阶，分别站在代理皇帝的两边。

英文原文: They turn around and face us, both standing at attention, arms straight down at their sides.
中文译文: 他们转过身来，面对着我们。两只狼都呈立正姿势，双臂垂直放在身体两侧。

英文原文: A drone levitates down from the ceiling, coming to a gentle stop midair in front of Cato.
中文译文: 一架无人机自天花板上落下，在Cato面前的空中轻轻停了下来。

英文原文: I notice the tiny red light on the top of the drone turn green, and the old wolf fixes his eyes on the camera.
中文译文: 我注意到无人机顶部小小的红灯变绿了，然后老狼看向镜头。

英文原文: "Welcome to the Trial of Rhetoric."
中文译文: “欢迎观看修辞选拔赛。”

英文原文: "Rhetoric has long been a staple of Wolven civilization and one of our greatest assets."
中文译文: “长久以来，修辞学始终是沃尔文文明的重要组成部分，也是我们最宝贵的财富之一。”

英文原文: "While known for our strength and tenacity, so too are we known for our use of words in negotiation."
中文译文: “虽然我们以力量和坚韧著称，但同样也以谈判的方式而闻名。”

英文原文: Neferu snorts next to me, loud enough that I wonder if Cato was able to hear it.
中文译文: 坐在我旁边的Neferu哼了一声，声音大到令我怀疑Cato能否听到。

英文原文: I hope not.
中文译文: 希望没有。

英文原文: "This is why it is not only important that we honor the art and history of debate today, but also prove our ability to use it well."
中文译文: “这就是为什么在今天，我们不仅要为辩论的艺术和历史感到自豪，还要证明我们能良好地运用它。”

英文原文: "Being a competent rhetorician is essential to being a competent emperor."
中文译文: “想要成为一名称职的皇帝，就必须先成为一名称职的修辞学家。”

英文原文: "Remember the rules; you will have the floor for twenty minutes. Do not reference your challenger. Now, Amicus—"
中文译文: “记住规则：每人二十分钟的发言时间。不要涉及到你的挑战者。现在，Amicus-”

英文原文: I see the slightest of twitches in Amicus's frame as he continues to stare ahead.
中文译文: Amicus依旧目视着前方，我看到他的身体略微抖动了一下。

英文原文: "Yes, emperor?"
中文译文: “是的，陛下？”

英文原文: "Please, honor Adastra and proceed to the floor. Offer your policies through the art of speech."
中文译文: “展示阿达斯特拉的荣光吧。请就位，通过发言的技巧阐述你的政策。”

英文原文: There's a slight pause, then Amicus makes his way down the stairs.
中文译文: 略微停顿之后，Amicus走下了楼梯。

英文原文: If he's nervous, which I know that he is, he's not showing it at all, his movements calm and reserved.
中文译文: 他的动作镇静而矜持，没有表现出丝毫紧张的样子-虽然我知道他确实在紧张。

英文原文: He walks several paces forward, away from the stairs to stand in the middle of the aisle, just slightly ahead of me.
中文译文: 他向前走了几步，离开楼梯站在了过道中间，就在我前面一点点的位置。

英文原文: He's so close, and I wish I could just say something, get up and give him a hug and tell him that he's gonna do great.
中文译文: 他离我很近，我真希望能做点什么：站起来给他一个拥抱，告诉他他会表现得很好。

英文原文: But I know that time is past, that the moment that everything has been building up to has just arrived.
中文译文: 不过我知道，那个时刻已经过去了。现在，是展示所有累积的成果的时间。

英文原文: It's a strange feeling, watching something that's going to have such a huge impact on your life, but not being able to participate at all.
中文译文: 这真是种奇怪的感觉：你眼睁睁看着会对自己的人生造成如此巨大影响的事情，却完全无法参与到其中。

英文原文: I can only hope that Amicus is ready.
中文译文: 我只能希望Amicus准备万全了。

英文原文: He begins to speak, and when he does, it's not like his usual voice.
中文译文: 他开始讲话了-用着不似平常的声音。

英文原文: Instead it's deeper, broader, sonorous, I guess.
中文译文: 更加的深厚、宽广和雄浑，我想。

英文原文: Actually, it's closer to human singing.
中文译文: 事实上，它更接近人类的歌唱声。

英文原文: "Twenty millennia ago, we were chosen by the Romanus."
中文译文: “两万年前，我们被Romanus所选择。”

英文原文: "Out of one thousand species, they chose us, and was that not for a reason?"
中文译文: “在茫茫一千个物种中，他们选择了我们，这难道毫无缘由吗？”

英文原文: He's moving his arms and paws a lot too, in broad sweeping motions.
中文译文: 他不停挥动着他的胳膊和爪子，动作幅度非常大。

英文原文: It's not unlike the dance, though he mostly stays in the same spot.
中文译文: 这和跳舞没什么两样，除了他基本上都待在原地以外。

英文原文: "Fifteen millennia ago, we rejected them, we became the first abandoned sibling, and our empire entered a decline of the likes that we had never seen before; closing off relations with siblings, losing children, losing resources—"
中文译文: “一万五千年前，我们拒绝了他们，成为了第一个被离弃的Sibling，我们的帝国也进入了前所未有的衰落。我们与Sibling们断绝了联系，遗失了Children、丧失了资源。”

英文原文: A drone floats around his body, and I can tell that he's playing up the performance to it, dramatically gesturing with overly-exaggerated expressions.
中文译文: 一架无人机围绕着他的身体飘来飘去，我看得出他是在对其进行夸张的表演，通过戏剧性的手势和丰富过头的表情。

英文原文: I realize that it's like I'm watching those dramas I've seen on Adastran television.
中文译文: 我感觉自己好像正在观看阿达斯特拉的电视上演的那些戏剧。

英文原文: "—We fell long and hard, as if our very moon was sucked into the pit. Five thousand years of misery and desolation, five thousand years until Drusus saved us all."
中文译文: “-衰落长久而彻底，仿佛我们的卫星被吸进了洞中。痛苦与荒凉持续了五千年，足足五千年，直至Drusus拯救了我们所有人。”

英文原文: Amicus goes on to describe the history that I had a vague knowledge of, how Drusus re-established contact with the parents, re-united the wolven empire and renamed the world Adastra, a name that represented everything the empire stood for.
中文译文: Amicus接下来描述了一段我大致了解的历史：Drusus是如何与Parent们重新建立了联系，重新统一了沃尔文帝国，并重新给这个社会命名为阿达斯特拉，这个名字作为帝国的象征代表了一切。

英文原文: "Since then, we've spread far and wide across the galaxy, found lost children, established roads to resources our moon desperately needed..."
中文译文: “自那以后，我们的足迹开始遍布整个星系，我们寻找回了Children，确立了我们的卫星补给稀缺资源的方式。”

英文原文: "But what we found to be most valuable? Rekindling diplomatic relations with the other siblings."
中文译文: “不过我们最有价值的发现是什么？是与其他Sibling们恢复了外交关系。”

英文原文: "With them, we shared knowledge and wealth, establishing ourselves as true siblings once again...until the war."
中文译文: “与他们一道，我们得以共享知识和财富，我们再次成为了真正的Sibling...直至那场战争。”

英文原文: "While our reasons were sound for initiating the conflict, the sudden and unexpected attack frightened the other siblings, leaving them to abandon us once more."
中文译文: “虽然我们挑起冲突的原因是合理的，但突如其来的进攻惊吓到了其他Sibling们，他们因而再次孤立了我们。”

英文原文: "We defended our rights and our dignity from the Khemians—"
中文译文: “我们从克米扬那里捍卫了我们的公正与尊严-”

英文原文: "Oh, Ahhotep..."
中文译文: “哦，Ahhotep...”

英文原文: Neferu mutters that under his breath, thankfully.
中文译文: Neferu发着牢骚，谢天谢地，他的声音压得很低。

英文原文: "But at a great cost. Our empire has suffered for our victory...but there is a way to reverse this."
中文译文: “不过，付出的代价是巨大的。为了这场胜利，我们的帝国蒙受着苦难...但是，有办法扭转这种局面。”

英文原文: I don't know if the wolf is doing a good job since I have no point of reference, but as far as I can tell, he seems to be doing great.
中文译文: 因为没有参照对象，我不知道狼的表现如何。但就我而言，他似乎表现得很棒。

英文原文: No stuttering, or stumbling, his acting pretty good, especially if I'm comparing him to the dramatic actors I've seen on the screens.
中文译文: 没有口吃，也没有拌嘴。他的演技相当不错，尤其是把他同电视上的其他戏剧演员相比。

英文原文: His movements are powerful, but elegant, just like his voice, and I find myself beaming with a sense of pride that I've never had for someone else before.
中文译文: 他的动作优雅而有力，声音也是如此。我发现自己正因为一种自豪感而微笑着，一种我之前从没有为他人感到过的自豪感。

英文原文: He goes on to describe the policies he'd already told me about: re-establish relations with the siblings, fully uplift the children, reshape their role in the the empire.
中文译文: 他下面表述了一些他跟我说过的政策：恢复与Sibling们的关系、全面提升Children的地位，以及重塑他们在帝国中的角色。

英文原文: "And the first step?"
中文译文: “而第一步是？”

英文原文: Amicus suddenly turns to face us, though his gaze is on Neferu.
中文译文: Amicus突然侧了个身，面朝着我们，他的目光落在Neferu身上。

英文原文: "An alliance, one that has been proposed by the Khemians."
中文译文: “联盟，一个由克米扬提出的建议。”

英文原文: "This may seem like a worrying prospect to you; it has never been done in the history of the {i}Galaxias{/i}, but I can promise that while emperor, I will demand respect and equal treatment from the Khemians."
中文译文: “对你们来说，这也许是个令人担忧的前景，这在{i}加拉西亚斯{/i}的历史上是前所未有的。但我能够保证，当我成为皇帝时，我会从克米扬那里争取到尊重与平等的待遇。”

英文原文: "Their arrogance will be tamed, and wolven dignity will be restored."
中文译文: “他们的傲慢将被驯化，沃尔文将重新取回尊严。”

英文原文: The light on the camera drone in front of us is green, broadcasting our image to the entirety of Adastra.
中文译文: 我们面前摄像无人机的灯是绿色的，意味着我们的图像被传播到了整个阿达斯特拉。

英文原文: I'm at least glad that Neferu is able to control his eye-rolling right now.
中文译文: 至少我很高兴Neferu控制住了自己没翻白眼。

英文原文: "Within the course of my rule, I will place Adastra on the same pedestal as all the other siblings, if not higher. No longer will we be the half-sibling of the {i}Galaxias{/i}."
中文译文: “在我的统治期间，我会令阿达斯特拉在所有Sibling中保持高等的地位，或至少同等水平。我们不再会是{i}加拉西亚斯{/i}中的-半Sibling-。”

英文原文: "No, we will once again stretch beyond our system, beyond our quadrant, and yes, eventually beyond the galaxy."
中文译文: “不再是。我们的延伸的足迹将再次超越我们的恒星系，超越我们的象限，以及终极的目标：超越星系。”

英文原文: Amicus points to the ceiling.
中文译文: Amicus指向天花板。

英文原文: "As Drusus proclaimed ten millennia ago; 'to the stars'."
中文译文: “正如Drusus在一万年前的宣告：‘为了群星’。”

英文原文: "So I say now; to the stars, and beyond."
中文译文: “现在，我在此声明：为了群星，超越群星。”

英文原文: Amicus pauses dramatically in that pose, then bows before turning and walking back to the throne.
中文译文: Amicus戏剧性地停顿了一下，然后鞠了一躬，转身走回了王座旁。

英文原文: "Thank you, Amicus. Cassius?"
中文译文: “谢谢你，Amicus。Cassius？”

英文原文: I let out a breath, watching as Amicus makes his way up the steps, passing Cassius as his brother makes his way to the same spot on the floor.
中文译文: 我呼出了一口气，目视着Amicus走上台阶，与走向他哥哥刚才位置的Cassius擦肩而过。

英文原文: So that's it.
中文译文: 所以，就这样了。

英文原文: Amicus's part is done.
中文译文: Amicus的部分已经完成了。

英文原文: Now it's Cassius's turn, and I watch as he walks to the same spot, an angry scowl on his face.
中文译文: 现在轮到Cassius了，我看着走到了同一个地方，满脸的怒容。

英文原文: It's angrier than usual, almost furious, and I wonder if he's upset about how well Amicus had done.
中文译文: 他的样子比平时更加生气，简直可以说是暴怒，不知道是不是因为对Amicus的表现而感到不安。

英文原文: But then he starts speaking, and I realize it's part of his show.
中文译文: 但当他开口说话时，我意识到这是他表演的一部分。

英文原文: "For three hundred years, our empire has been in shambles!"
中文译文: “三百年来，我们的帝国一片狼藉！”

英文原文: I jump, and I even feel Neferu tense up next to me as the white wolf practically screams.
中文译文: 我吓了一跳，我甚至感觉到身旁的Neferu也因为白狼接近尖叫的声音而绷紧了肌肉。

英文原文: "Not because of the war, not because we chose a different path. No, this is {i}because{/i} of Drusus and his flawed vision of the {i}Galaxias{/i} as a whole!"
中文译文: “不是因为战争，不是因为我们选择了不同的道路。不是，而是{i}因为{/i}Drusus和他对整个{i}加拉西亚斯{/i}短浅的目光！”

英文原文: "My brother was right about ONE thing...Adastra is the lowest of the low amongst the siblings, the laughingstock of the entire galaxy!"
中文译文: “我哥哥有-一件-事是对的...那就是阿达斯特拉在所有Sibling中的地位处于最底层，是整个星系的笑柄！”

英文原文: "No references to Amicus, Cassius!"
中文译文: “不要涉及Amicus，Cassius！”

英文原文: Cato barks from across the throneroom, but the other wolf ignores him, swiping his paw through the air, his movements aggressive and violent.
中文译文: Cato在王座上厉声说道，但另一只狼无视了他，爪子在空中划过，动作咄咄逼人而迅猛。

英文原文: "ENOUGH of being the butt of jokes, of being spat upon, of being considered at the level of mere children!"
中文译文: “我们已经-受够了-沦为笑柄、被唾弃、还有被认为和Children同一水平了！”

英文原文: "It is time for Adastra to once again be respected, revered...and feared, just like before Drusus."
中文译文: “现在是时候，让阿达斯特拉重新被尊重、崇敬...还有恐惧，就像Drusus之前的时代那样。”

英文原文: Cassius's speech goes on like that, describing Adastra in terms that make it sound like the worst place in the galaxy to be.
中文译文: Cassius继续着这样的演讲，他描述里的阿达斯特拉听起来就像是全星系最糟糕的地方似的。

英文原文: I don't know if this is good or not.
中文译文: 我不知道这是好还是不好。

英文原文: He's definitely being way more intense than Amicus was, and if that's the goal, then I'm worried.
中文译文: 他肯定比Amicus还要紧张，但如果这就是他的目的，那么我很担心。

英文原文: I glance over at Neferu and Virginia, and the troubled looks on their faces tell me that I should be even more worried.
中文译文: 我瞥了Neferu和Virginia一眼，他们脸上的愁容告诉我，我更应该担心才对。

英文原文: I look up toward the throne, but Amicus is as still and straight-faced as ever.
中文译文: 我朝王座那边看去，不过Amicus依旧面无表情，从始至终都是。

英文原文: I feel myself start to sweat, wondering if this is the beginning of the end.
中文译文: 我的汗水开始涌现了出现，不知道这是否就是结束的开始。

英文原文: "My brother stated that the war was responsible for our sudden decline, a decline not so sudden when it's been happening for thousands of years!"
中文译文: “我哥哥说战争是我们突然衰落的罪魁祸首，但这种持续了几千年的衰落一点也不突然！”

英文原文: "No, that war was the best thing that could have ever happened to this empire. It showed that we were unafraid, unintimidated by the most powerful force in the galaxy!"
中文译文: “不，那场战争是这个帝国有史以来发生过的最值得的事件。它表明我们无所畏惧，不向星系中最强大的力量低头！”

英文原文: "We were mocked and laughed at openly before the war! Now, those laughs are quieter, behind dainty paws as our siblings realize just how dangerous we can be. They take us seriously now..."
中文译文: “我们在战前遭受了公开的蔑视和嘲笑！现在，当我们的Sibling们意识到我们有多危险时，那些笑声全部安静了，他们正严肃地看待我们...”

英文原文: Cassius turns his angry gaze on us.
中文译文: Cassius把愤怒的目光投了过来。

英文原文: "...but not seriously enough. Look who they sent to propose this...this {i}alliance{/i} that my brother spoke of."
中文译文: “...但是还不够。看看他们派遣了谁来商议这个...我哥哥说的这个{i}联盟{/i}。”

英文原文: "No references to Amicus, Cassius."
中文译文: “不要涉及Amicus，Cassius。”

英文原文: But Cato is quieter now, as if he knows he can't stop the young wolf.
中文译文: 不过这次Cato的声音比较轻，就好像他知道阻止不了那个年轻的狼。

英文原文: Our camera light turns green, and I once again get the feeling that the broadcast is displaying Neferu.
中文译文: 我们的摄像机再次变成了绿灯，我再次感觉到了电视上正播放着Neferu。

英文原文: "The one and only Flower of Khemia. The pharaoh's faggot son with his oils and perfumes, stinking up the halls of our palace!"
中文译文: “克米扬的花儿，也是唯一的花儿。法老的同性恋儿子用他的油和香水，把我们皇宫的走廊弄得臭烘烘的！”

英文原文: I glance up at Neferu, but his expression has hardly changed, though I see a hint of a smirk on his lips.
中文译文: 我抬头瞄了一眼Neferu，但他的表情几乎没有变，不过我看到他嘴唇上勾起了一丝微笑。

英文原文: Meanwhile, Virginia is hiding a look of shock, or horror...or both, behind her fan.
中文译文: 与此同时，Virginia用扇子隐藏着后面震惊，或者惊栗...又或者两者皆是的样子。

英文原文: "This alliance is highly suspect, and I must wonder what is really going on during these...negotiations. Actually, let me give you an idea."
中文译文: “这个联盟非常的可疑，我不得不好奇在这些...谈判的过程中到底发生了什么。事实上，我可以为你们提供一个方向。”

英文原文: Cassius makes a sort of signal with his paw, then pauses.
中文译文: Cassius用爪子发出了某种信号，然后停了下来。

英文原文: Everything is silent for a moment, and looking at the cameras...none of them are green.
中文译文: 一切都陷入了短暂的安静中，那些摄像机...没有一台是绿灯。

英文原文: I look around at the others and can tell that they're confused as well.
中文译文: 我环顾四周，可以看出其他人也很困惑。

英文原文: "What are you broadcasting, Cassius?"
中文译文: “你要播放什么，Cassius？”

英文原文: Cassius doesn't even turn around to acknowledge Cato.
中文译文: Cassius甚至没有转身去向Cato致意。

英文原文: "Just showing a small video clip."
中文译文: “只是一个简短的视频片段。”

英文原文: "Of what?"
中文译文: “关于什么？”

英文原文: I see Amicus bristling next to Cato, and I feel the hair standing up on my own neck.
中文译文: 我看着Cato旁边的Amicus怒不可遏的样子，同时也感觉到自己脖子上的寒毛因愤怒耸立了起来。

英文原文: "Of a traitorous act between my brother and the flower jackal."
中文译文: “关于我哥哥和胡狼的背叛行为。”

英文原文: "What!?"
Amicus is so puffed out he looks almost twice his natural size.
中文译文: Amicus急促地喘息着，他的身影看起来几乎是平常的两倍。

英文原文: "What are you doing!?"
中文译文: “你在做什么！？”

英文原文: "Yes Cassius, what {i}are{/i} you doing?"
中文译文: “是的，Cassius，你在{i}做{/i}什么？”

英文原文: "Cato, he bugged my room!"
中文译文: “Cato，他在我房间里装监视器！”

英文原文: Amicus starts to move, but Cato reaches out from his throne to hold him back.
中文译文: Amicus移动了，但王座上的Cato伸出爪子阻止了他。

英文原文: "Stay there, brother, it's almost over. And don't worry; it's censored."
中文译文: “别动，哥哥，已经快播完了。还有别担心：这是删减过的。”

英文原文: Cassius sneers back at Amicus before the red light on his drone suddenly turns green again.
中文译文: Cassius在他的无人机上的红灯突然变绿之前，回头讥讽着Amicus。

英文原文: Cassius stares at the lens for a moment, letting the silence drag out for dramatic effect.
中文译文: Cassius盯着镜头看了好一会儿，让沉默拖延出戏剧般的效果。

英文原文: "Shocking, is it not? I already described the Flower of Khemia...do we also want the Flower of Adastra to be our emperor?"
中文译文: “令人震惊，不是吗？我已经描述过克米扬的花儿了...难道我们还想让阿达斯特拉的花儿成为我们的皇帝吗？”

英文原文: "Time, Cassius."
中文译文: “时间，Cassius。”

英文原文: Cato's voice is soft, sounding almost astonished.
中文译文: Cato的声音很温和，听起来几乎十分惊讶。

英文原文: Amicus is clearly having a much harder time keeping his emotions in check now.
中文译文: Amicus现在显然很难控制住自己的情绪。

英文原文: Even from this distance, I can see him working his jaw.
中文译文: 即使有一段距离，我也能看到他正紧咬着下巴。

英文原文: But Cassius doesn't seem to be finished.
中文译文: 但是Cassius似乎还没说完。

英文原文: "And let me leave you with this—"
中文译文: “我就留给你们自己想吧-”

英文原文: "TIME, Cassius. Yield the floor!"
中文译文: “时间，Cassius。结束发言！”

英文原文: "No, I will not yield! Adastra is the one out of time! This empire is stretched thin, and that tail-raiser proposes that we stretch even further! When do we break!?"
中文译文: “不，我是不会屈服的！阿达斯特拉已经跟不上时代了！这个帝国为了延伸已经十分艰难，而那个翘尾巴还在建议我们继续扩张！我们什么时候才能够休息！？”

英文原文: Cassius whirls around and points a finger at Amicus.
中文译文: Cassius转了过去，用爪子指着Amicus。

英文原文: "He looks toward the children and the siblings while completely ignoring US!"
中文译文: “他的眼里全是Children和Sibling，却完全没考虑过-我们-！”

英文原文: Cassius's bristled fur slowly starts to lay down again, the wolf making a show of trying to get himself under control again.
中文译文: Cassius的鬃毛慢慢倒下，那只狼再次演出了控制住自己的样子。

英文原文: "So...let me leave you with this; while campaigning in the outskirts of Adastra city, areas my brother completely neglected, I came across a young child with the same disease that afflicts me."
中文译文: “那么...我把这个留给你们：在阿达斯特拉城的边缘地带，一个我哥哥完全忽略了的地区，我在竞选时遇到了一个被和我一样的疾病折磨着的孩子。”

英文原文: Cassius's voice becomes much more quiet, gentle, lowering his muzzle a bit to stare at the floor.
中文译文: Cassius的声音变得非常安静、轻柔，他的头略微低下，看着地板。

英文原文: "Unlike me, she had no medication to speak of because her poor, farming family could not afford it. She was bound to a wheelchair, her bones so frail that something as simple as a bath causes them to dislocate and break."
中文译文: “与我不同，她没有相应的药物，因为她贫穷的务农家庭无力承担。她被固定在轮椅上，骨头脆弱到洗澡这样的小事都会导致脱臼和骨折。”

英文原文: Cassius's voice catches and, to my surprise, I see a tear slide down his cheek.
中文译文: Cassius的声音停了一下，出乎我的意料，我看到一滴眼泪顺着他的脸颊滑落。

英文原文: "How dare this empire let our people fall into such a state that we cannot even care for our own people. I'm hearing that even now, we can't afford to vaccinate those beyond our glittering city."
中文译文: “我们甚至无法关照他们，这个帝国怎么敢让我们的人民陷入如此的状况。我听说，即使是现在，我们也无法为光彩夺目的城市之外的地区提供疫苗。”

英文原文: Cassius looks back up at the camera.
中文译文: Cassius回头看着摄像机。

英文原文: "It may seem as if we cannot hear you past the walls of this palace, but I hear you. I promise to always hear you. I will not cater to the needs and wants of the siblings or children, to the Adastra City elites or officials."
中文译文: “-我们-似乎听不到皇宫墙壁外的你们，但是-我-听到了，我保证会永远聆听你们的声音。我不会去迎合Siblings、Children、还有阿达斯特拉城的上层集团和官员们的需求。”

英文原文: Cassius sweeps a paw dramatically to his chest.
中文译文: Cassius戏剧性地用爪子掠过他的胸膛。

英文原文: "Not 'to the stars', but to YOU, the people of the empire...Thank you."
中文译文: “不是为了‘群星’，而是为‘你们’，为了帝国的人民们...谢谢。”

英文原文: Cassius bows low to the camera before turning to walk back to the throne.
中文译文: Cassius鞠了一躬，转身走回王座旁。

英文原文: There's a long moment of silence as we all just stare at the white wolf, then Com's voice crackles over our heads.
中文译文: 沉默持续了很长一段时间，我们都只是在盯着白狼看，然后Com的电子音在我们头上响了起来。

英文原文: "Triumvirates, make your decisions."
中文译文: “三人执政团们，做出你们的决定。”

英文原文: Suddenly, I feel something grasp me around the wrist and look down to see Neferu's furry, black paw holding on to me.
中文译文: 突然，我感觉有什么东西抓住了我的手腕。低头一看，Neferu毛茸茸的黑色爪子紧紧握住了我。

英文原文: "[mc], very quietly, we are going to get up and head to my room. We'll move around the back so that the camera's do not see."
中文译文: “[mc]，保持安静，我们起身去我的房间。先绕到后面去，摄像机拍不到那里。”

英文原文: "Why?"
中文译文: “为什么？”

英文原文: "Because what Amicus had feared is about to—"
中文译文: “因为Amicus担心的-”

英文原文: "The triumvirates have made their decisions."
中文译文: “三人执政团们已经做出了决定。”

英文原文: I see Neferu's eyes widen in surprise.
中文译文: 我看到Neferu惊讶地睁大了眼睛。

英文原文: "Already?"
中文译文: “这么快？”

英文原文: He seems to say it to himself, but he stands and I have to stand with him as he starts to walk up the aisle, toward the back of the room, pulling me along with him.
中文译文: 他似乎是在自言自语，不过他站了起来，我也不得不和他一起。他沿着过道，拉着我向房间后面走去。

英文原文: I look back at Amicus and see the wolf looking right back at me, finally.
中文译文: 我回头望向Amicus，背后的那只狼也终于，回望了过来。

英文原文: His eyes are full of worry and regret, and I can tell that everyone knows that Cassius has won.
中文译文: 他的眼睛里充满了忧虑和遗憾，我敢说所有人都知道是Cassius赢了。

英文原文: My stomach drops and I realize that what I've been terrified of happening all month is actually happening.
中文译文: 我的胃沉了下来，我整月都在害怕的事情真的发生了。

英文原文: We've lost.
中文译文: 我们输了。

英文原文: I can only stare at Neferu's muscular arm as it pulls me toward the doors, toward an unknown and unwanted future...
中文译文: 我木然地看着Neferu肌肉发达的手臂，它拉着我朝向大门，朝向一个未知的、讨厌的未来...

英文原文: "Lupas—"
中文译文: “鲁帕斯-”

英文原文: After all this time, after everything we'd done...we've lost.
中文译文: 在过了这么长时间以后，在我们做了一切努力之后...我们还是输了。

英文原文: "Amicus."
中文译文: “Amicus。”

英文原文: Neferu pauses.
中文译文: Neferu停了下来。

英文原文: I look up at the ceiling, toward where I always imagine Com to be if he were real, then I look back at the throne.
中文译文: 我抬头仰望着天花板，朝着我一直以来想象中的Com的位置-如果他是真实存在的话-望去，然后我回头看向王座。

英文原文: "Ad Rotae: Amicus."
中文译文: “艾德.罗迪：Amicus。”

英文原文: Amicus looks just as shocked as I am.
中文译文: Amicus看起来和我一样震惊。

英文原文: Cassius, meanwhile, has his jaw set grimly.
中文译文: 与此同时，Cassius，他的下巴紧绷着。

英文原文: As always, I can't read Cato.
中文译文: 一如既往地，我读不懂Cato的表情。

英文原文: "Lux: Amicus."
中文译文: “卢克斯：Amicus。”

英文原文: "Gebii: Amicus."
中文译文: “格比：Amicus。”

英文原文: What the hell is going on?
中文译文: 到底怎么回事？

英文原文: It had just seemed like everyone thought Cassius was going to win, and if it was all based on performance...then he should be winning.
中文译文: 刚才似乎所有人都认为Cassius会赢，而且如果一切都是基于表演的话...那么他应该是胜利者。

英文原文: "Tricelli: Amicus."
中文译文: “特拉维斯：Amicus。”

英文原文: There's a pause, one that has me realizing that we just...won?
中文译文: 在这里有一个停顿，使我得以意识到，我们刚刚...赢了？

英文原文: Did we really just win?
中文译文: 我们真的赢了？

英文原文: "Adastra?"
中文译文: “阿达斯特拉？”

英文原文: Cato is staring straight ahead with his visor, and now I can see his paws gripping into the armrests of his throne.
中文译文: Cato透过他的面甲笔直凝视着前方，他的爪子紧握着王座扶手。

英文原文: The silence goes on so long that Com asks again.
中文译文: 沉默持续了非常之久，以至于Com再次问道。

英文原文: "Adastra?"
中文译文: “阿达斯特拉？”

英文原文: Cato lets the silence continue for several more seconds before finally opening his muzzle.
中文译文: Cato继续沉默了几秒钟，然后终于开了口。

英文原文: "Cassius."
中文译文: “Cassius。”

英文原文: I don't know what to think, but Com immediately responds.
中文译文: 我的大脑一片空白，不过Com立即做出了回答。

英文原文: "The trial has been decided. Amicus is the victor."
中文译文: “比赛结果已经确定。胜利者是Amicus。”

英文原文: The silence that follows this time is deafening.
中文译文: 接下来是如同死一般的寂静。

英文原文: No one cheers, no one moves.
中文译文: 没有人欢呼，没有人移动。

英文原文: Even Virginia's fan is frozen, as if we're all stuck in a picture.
中文译文: 就连Virginia的扇子也停下了，仿佛我们被困在了一张照片里。

英文原文: All the while, the cameras continue to hover over our heads, each one of them flashing green for a moment.
中文译文: 摄像机始终在我们头上盘旋着，它们每一个都闪了一会儿绿色的光。

英文原文: Finally, Com is again the one to break the silence.
中文译文: 终于，Com再一次打破了沉默。

英文原文: "This concludes the second trial. Thank you."
中文译文: “第二场选拔赛结束。感谢你们。”

英文原文: With that, the camera lights turn off completely and the drones hover up toward the compartment in the ceiling.
中文译文: 说完，摄像机上的光完全熄灭，无人机盘旋着飘进了天花板的隔层里。

英文原文: The lights come back on.
中文译文: 光线亮了回来。

英文原文: As they do, Neferu is once again pulling me toward the doors.
中文译文: 在这一切发生的同时，Neferu继续把我拉向了大门。

英文原文: I want to hold back and watch, but the jackal is insistent, and the next thing I know, the doors are quietly sliding open, and we're walking into the equally silent, though much less tense, atmosphere of the marble halls.
中文译文: 我想要留下继续观看，不过胡狼十分坚持。我反应过来的时候，门已经静静地滑开了，我们走进了同样寂静，但没有被紧张气氛所包围的大理石走廊里。

英文原文: "Where are we going? We just won."
中文译文: “我们去哪儿？我们已经赢了。”

英文原文: As I say that, I feel the excitement finally replace the shock.
中文译文: 就在我说话的同时，我感到兴奋终于取代了震惊。

英文原文: We won!
中文译文: 我们赢了！

英文原文: "Neferu, we wo—"
中文译文: “Neferu，我们赢-”

英文原文: "Clearly, but that does not mean you are safe, yet."
中文译文: “很明显，但是这并不意味着你安全了，目前来说。”

英文原文: "What?"
中文译文: “什么？”

英文原文: Neferu is quiet for a moment, at this point the jackal having let go of my hand, allowing me to just follow behind him.
中文译文: Neferu沉默了一会儿，然后胡狼才放开我的手，我不用被迫跟着他了。

英文原文: "What even happened?"
中文译文: “怎么回事？”

英文原文: "Who do you think should have won, [mc]?"
中文译文: “你认为谁应该赢，[mc]？”

英文原文: I frown.
中文译文: 我皱起了眉。

英文原文: "Does that matter? The triumvirates decided. Amicus won."
中文译文: “有什么关系？三人执政团已经决定了。是Amicus赢了。”

英文原文: "True, but not just the triumvirates were watching. We all know who should have won."
中文译文: “不错，但并非只有三人执政团在看。我们都知道应该赢的是谁。”

英文原文: I feel myself getting defensive.
中文译文: 我开始辩解。

英文原文: "Cassius was being a total asshole, and besides, he cheated. He went over his allowed time AND referenced Amicus and his points."
中文译文: “Cassius就是个十足的混蛋，而且，他还作了弊。他超出了允许的时间，还涉及到Amicus和他的论点。”

英文原文: Neferu laughs mirthlessly.
中文译文: Neferu淡淡地笑了。

英文原文: "The rules do not matter. I'm sure you've probably realized that by now. Cassius did exactly as he should have...but he lost because of you."
中文译文: “规则无关紧要。相信你现在应该已经意识到了。Cassius已经尽了全力...但他还是输了，因为你。”

英文原文: "What?"
"The triumvirates clearly made their decisions long before the trial. We were hoping that they would not go against the will of the people, but Cassius's performance forced them to."
中文译文: “三人执政团们显然在比赛之前就已经做好了决定。我们希望他们不会违背人民的意愿，但是Cassius迫使他们这样做。”

英文原文: "You're talking about the rumor about Cassius getting rid of them?"
中文译文: “你说的是Cassius意图废除他们的谣言？”

英文原文: "That would be the one. I had thought that such a clearly lopsided win on Cassius's part would have deterred at least most of them. Their hunger for power is insatiable, it seems."
中文译文: “正是。我原以为Cassius如此一边倒的优势，至少会威慑到他们中的大多数。不过看来，他们对权力的渴望永远也得不到满足。”

英文原文: Again, I feel myself getting defensive, but there's also a sense of worry creeping in.
中文译文: 我再次开始了辩解，但是同时，一种担心的感觉悄然出现。

英文原文: "Well...I don't know, I think Amicus did great. Besides, it's THEIR role to keep the emperor's power in check anyway, isn't it?"
中文译文: “唔...我不明白，不过我觉得Amicus也表现得很好啊。再说，-他们-的职责就是限制皇帝的权利，不是吗？”

英文原文: "Yes, but that's not the point of the trials, and the people know that. Adastra will not be happy about this."
中文译文: “是的，但那不是比赛的重点，民众们也都知道。阿达斯特拉不会感到高兴的。”

英文原文: "Well...what does that mean, then?"
中文译文: “...那是什么意思？”

英文原文: We come to a stop in front of Amicus's room, and finally, the jackal turns to face me.
中文译文: 我们在Amicus的房间前停了下来，在最后，胡狼转过身来直面着我。

英文原文: "That I cannot tell you. I am not an expert on the politics of Adastra, I am simply a student here. Amicus may have won this battle, but I can guarantee that the power struggle is far from over."
中文译文: “我不能告诉你。我不是阿达斯特拉的政治家，在这里我不过是一个学者。或许Amicus赢了这场仗，不过我可以保证，权利的争斗远未结束。”

英文原文: "Amicus can explain more to you when he arrives. For now, wait for him in his room."
中文译文: “Amicus来了以后可以向你解释得更明白。现在，在他房间里等他吧。”

英文原文: The jackal starts to turn to leave, but seems to notice the confused, and probably worried look on my face.
中文译文: 胡狼正要转身离开，但他似乎注意到了我脸上困惑，可能还夹杂着担心的表情。

英文原文: He pauses, then sets a paw on my shoulder.
中文译文: 他停了下来，把爪子放在我的肩膀上。

英文原文: "Do not fret too much over this. It is par for the course in Wolven politics, that much I do know. Drama is their identity, and we can only be along for the ride."
中文译文: “别为此感到太过不安。就我所知，这在沃尔文的政治中是司空见惯的。戏剧是他们的本体，而我们只能顺其自然。”

英文原文: Neferu smiles at me.
中文译文: Neferu对我微笑了一下。

英文原文: "Amicus will keep you safe, and if there's a need you have that he cannot fulfill, I am also here."
中文译文: “Amicus会保护你的安全，如果他无法满足你的需求，还有我在。”

英文原文: I know Neferu intends for that to sound salacious, but I also think he means it...in a nice way.
中文译文: 我知道Neferu故意把这句话说得很暧昧，但我同样认为他是认真的...以一种恰如其分的方式。

英文原文: I put my hand on his paw.
中文译文: 我把手放在他的爪子上。

英文原文: "Thanks."
中文译文: “谢谢。”

英文原文: The jackal nods at me before turning away to walk up the hall, probably toward his own room.
中文译文: 胡狼朝我点点头，然后转身，沿着走廊远去了，也许是回他自己的房间。

英文原文: Once he's out of sight, I press my hand to the panel and walk into Amicus's room, sitting on the sofa to wait.
中文译文: 在他离开了我的视野后，我把手按在嵌板上，走进了Amicus的房间，坐在沙发上等待着。

英文原文: It's strange...Amicus won, but it doesn't exactly feel that way after what Neferu just told me.
中文译文: 很奇怪...Amicus赢了，但在Neferu告诉了我那些后，感觉实际上又并非如此。

英文原文: Amicus didn't genuinely win...we'd won because of a rumor, basically making the entire trial thing pointless.
中文译文: Amicus不是真的赢了...我们的胜利是因为一个谣言，一个基本上令整个选拔变得毫无意义的谣言。

英文原文: Still, I can't exactly feel bad about that.
中文译文: 不过，我没有为此感到难过。

英文原文: Cassius bugged this very room to show footage of Amicus fucking Neferu.
中文译文: Cassius监视了这个房间，还播放了Amicus和Neferu的性爱镜头。

英文原文: I close my eyes, rubbing them with a hand as I realize how much that might have damaged Amicus's reputation.
中文译文: 我闭上双眼，用手指揉搓着，思考这会对Amicus的名誉造成多大的损害。

英文原文: Not only do the people realize this trial was decided from the beginning by corrupt triumvirates, but also that their soon-to-be emperor had sex with a male...a Khemian male at that.
中文译文: 人民不仅会意识到，这场比赛的结果一开始就由腐败的三人执政团决定了，而且他们未来的皇帝与一名男性...一名克米扬男性发生了性关系。

英文原文: But again, Cassius losing because of his intention to get rid of one of the few checks on his power seems like karma to me.
中文译文: 但同样的，Cassius失败的原因，就是因为他想要摆脱对其权利的少数制约之一。在我看来这就是报应。

英文原文: Weren't they keeping the emperor's power in check by making the decision that they did?
中文译文: 他们之所以这样做，不正是为了限制皇帝的权利吗？

英文原文: Technically, Amicus will become emperor now, though I guess it won't be official until Cassius actually concedes the third trial.
中文译文: 严格意义上来说，Amicus现在即将成为皇帝。不过我想在Cassius真正放弃了第三场比赛之前，这不会是正式的。

英文原文: I turn these thoughts over and over in my head for the next 20 minutes, a bit annoyed by the fact that even though I got exactly what I wanted, several issues had come with it.
中文译文: 在接下来的二十分钟里，我把这些想法在脑子里转了一遍又一遍。我有些恼火，因为我虽然得到了想要的结果，但是又有其他问题接踵而至。

英文原文: Suddenly, the door slides open, and I forget my worry for just a moment as I see Amicus standing there.
中文译文: 突然，门滑开了。看到Amicus站在那里，我暂时忘记了我的担心。

英文原文: He only gets a few steps into the room before I'm already there, wrapping my arms around his body as I hug him.
中文译文: 他几步就走到了我的身前。我拥抱着他，他搂着我的胳膊。

英文原文: "Whoa! Hey, [mc]. Everything alright?"
中文译文: “哇哦！嘿，[mc]。一切都好吗？”

英文原文: The wolf sets a heavy paw on my head, rubbing the pads gently against my scalp.
中文译文: 狼的一只爪子重重地落在我的头上，肉垫轻轻摩擦着我的头皮。

英文原文: "Are you?"
中文译文: “你怎么样？”

英文原文: "Of course."
中文译文: “当然好了。”

英文原文: Amicus smiles down at me warmly, but having known him this long, I know that's not exactly true.
中文译文: Amicus热情地冲我笑了起来，但我认识他这么久了，我知道这不是真实的。

英文原文: "Well...we won."
中文译文: “嗯...我们赢了。”

英文原文: "We did."
中文译文: “我们做到了。”

英文原文: He's quiet for a bit, continuing to rub my head.
中文译文: 他沉默了一会儿，继续揉着我的头。

英文原文: "This isn't really how I imagined it would go."
中文译文: “这和我想象中的不一样。”

英文原文: Amicus laughs softly.
中文译文: Amicus轻轻地笑了。

英文原文: "Hahaha...neither did I, but we did win, and that's the important part."
中文译文: “哈哈哈...我也没想到，不过我们赢了，这才是重要的。”

英文原文: Amicus hugs me tightly again.
中文译文: Amicus再次牢牢抱住了我。

英文原文: "Is what Cassius did, what he showed...how bad was that?"
中文译文: “Cassius的行为，他播放的那个...有多糟？”

英文原文: Amicus grimaces.
中文译文: Amicus露出了愁容。

英文原文: "Bad, but I'll find a way to get through that. Seems my first job as emperor will be rebuilding my image."
中文译文: “很糟，但我会想办法解决的。看来我成为皇帝后，第一份工作就是重塑我的形象。”

英文原文: "When do you become emperor?"
中文译文: “你什么时候能成为皇帝？”

英文原文: "As soon as Cassius gives up. I don't think he's in the mood to do that quite yet, though."
中文译文: “当Cassius放弃的时候。不过，我认为他目前还不会这样做。”

英文原文: We stand there for a while, Amicus continuing to stroke my head as I lean it against his chest, listening to the soft beat of his heart.
中文译文: 我们在那里站了有一段时间，我把头靠在他胸前，听着他心脏轻轻跳动的声音，而他继续轻抚着我的头。

英文原文: "I'm just glad it's over."
中文译文: “我很高兴一切都结束了。”

英文原文: "I feel the same."
中文译文: “我也有同感。”

英文原文: "So what next?"
中文译文: “接下来呢？”

英文原文: "Well...for now, I must go to the city. The triumvirates requested the imperial family be seen at once."
中文译文: “嗯...目前来说，我必须前往城市。三人执政团们请求立刻会见皇室成员们。”

英文原文: "Oh, why?"
中文译文: “喔，为什么？”

英文原文: "Well, everyone assumes the trials to be over. They'd like to discuss things with the family before they leave Adastra for their own cities."
中文译文: “这个吗，所有人都认为选拔其实已经结束了。他们想在离开阿达斯特拉回自己的城市之前，和皇室成员们讨论一些事情。”

英文原文: "I see."
中文译文: “明白了。”

英文原文: "They also requested that you go."
中文译文: “他们还要求你去。”

英文原文: I lean back to look up at the wolf.
中文译文: 我仰头看着这只狼。

英文原文: "Really?"
中文译文: “真的吗？”

英文原文: "Yes, though I told them not to expect it. I know you wanted to see the city, but it's up to you...well, it won't be the actual city, just the district where the delegates live. Things are a bit...chaotic in the city center at the moment."
中文译文: “是的，虽然我告诉他们不要期待。我知道你想去城市里看看，不过这取决于你...好吧，它并不是真正的城市，只是代表们居住的地区。现在的市中心有一些...混乱。”

英文原文: "Chaotic?"
中文译文: “混乱？”

英文原文: "The citizens are...excited after the trial."
中文译文: “比赛结束后，市民们都很...激动。”

英文原文: "Ah."
I imagine excited means angry.
中文译文: 我想，激动意味着愤怒。

英文原文: "I could...but doing official stuff seems kinda scary."
中文译文: “我可以去...但是，做一些官方的事情好像有点儿吓人。”

英文原文: "You wouldn't have to do anything, just look happy to be there, but it's up to you."
中文译文: “你什么也不用做，只要看起来很高兴在那里就好，不过这取决于你。”

英文原文: "Would it help you?"
中文译文: “这会对你有帮助吗？”

英文原文: "Possibly, I would certainly be happy to have you there."
中文译文: “也许吧，有你在我一定会很高兴的。”

英文原文: "Then sure."
中文译文: “那就这么决定了。”

英文原文: The wolf's eyebrows go up in surprise.
中文译文: 狼惊讶地竖起了眉毛。

英文原文: "Oh, really? Well alright then. Let's go."
中文译文: “噢，真的吗？那好，我们走吧。”

英文原文: "Now?"
中文译文: “现在？”

英文原文: "Yes, I believe the others are already in the chariot. Are you ready?"
中文译文: “是的，我相信其他人已经在马车里了。你准备好了吗？”

英文原文: "I...think so, unless I need to bring anything."
中文译文: “我...应该吧，除非我需要带什么东西。”

英文原文: "Not at all. And sorry, I know things are moving fast at the moment. It's to be expected after the trial, but we can talk in private when we get back, alright?"
中文译文: “什么也不用。还有抱歉，我知道现在事情发展得很快，在比赛结后这是可以预见的。不过，我们可以回来后再私下谈谈，好吗？”

英文原文: "Okay."
Amicus is already turning to pull me along, but I stop him.
中文译文: Amicus已经转身开始拉着我，不过我停下了。

英文原文: When he turns, I do what I'd wanted to do since right before the trial started, and I kiss him on the lips.
中文译文: 他一转回来，我就做了在比赛前想做的事，吻向他的嘴唇。

英文原文: The chariot is really just a large, metallic carriage.
中文译文: 马车真的就只是一辆巨大的，金属制的马车。

英文原文: It has benches inside with an open top.
中文译文: 它敞着蓬，里面有几张长凳。

英文原文: There are no horses, of course, and it seems to move on its own.
中文译文: 当然了，没有马，它似乎是自行移动的。

英文原文: It is the first time that I've ever seen wheels being used for transportation here, though.
中文译文: 不过，这是我第一次在这里看到有轮子的运输工具。

英文原文: As we're walking up to it, I notice Virginia and Neferu already sitting in the front...and Cassius is in the back with Alex.
中文译文: 我们走过去时，我注意到Virginia和Neferu已经坐在了前面...还有Cassius和Alex在后面坐着。

英文原文: He's very deliberately looking away from us.
中文译文: 他非常刻意地把视线避开我们。

英文原文: I whisper to Amicus as we get closer to the chariot.
中文译文: 我一边和Amicus小声说着话，一边走近了马车。

英文原文: "Cassius is going?"
中文译文: “Cassius也要去？”

英文原文: "Yes...I think Cato made him go."
中文译文: “对...我想是Cato让他去的。”

英文原文: Despite everything the white wolf has done, especially in the trial, I can't help but feel a little sorry for him.
中文译文: 尽管白狼做了那么多事，尤其是比赛中的那些，我还是忍不住为他感到一丝遗憾。

英文原文: I can't imagine having to go out in public right after your years-long campaign was defeated.
中文译文: 我无法想象，多年的运营被击败后，还必须公开露面是什么样的感受。

英文原文: Amicus hops in first, sitting next to Virginia before reaching down to me to pull me up next to him.
中文译文: Amicus率先跳了进去，坐在Virginia身旁，然后伸爪把我拉到了他旁边。

英文原文: "I'd thought we'd be flying there."
中文译文: “我还以为我们会飞过去。”

英文原文: "We usually do, but since the ship we used to take to the city, uh, crashed a few months ago, we decided the chariot is safer and more inconspicuous."
中文译文: “以前是，不过自从几个月前我们去城里的那艘飞船，唔，坠毁后，我们就选择了更安全，也更不显眼的马车。”

英文原文: "Yes, something that will come in handy considering the state of the city right now."
中文译文: “不错，考虑到城市目前的状况，某些东西会派上用场的。”

英文原文: "Yes."
中文译文: “是的。”

英文原文: "What's the state of the city?"
中文译文: “城市的状况怎么了？”

英文原文: Virginia fixes her eyes on me, really looking at me for the first time in a while.
中文译文: Virginia将目光固定在了我身上，她有史以来第一次真正地看着我。

英文原文: "Riots, looting, the usual, though a bit unusual for Adastra City compared to say, Lux."
中文译文: “暴乱、抢劫，司空见惯，不过和卢克斯相比，阿达斯特拉城还算好点了。”

英文原文: Amicus glances at me, but that's when there's a sudden jerk as the chariot moves forward, toward the tree line.
中文译文: Amicus瞥了我一眼，不过就在这时，伴随着一阵突然的推动，马车开始朝前方的林木线驶去。

英文原文: Virginia looks at Amicus.
中文译文: Virginia看向Amicus。

英文原文: "I must say, your pet is much more fascinating than I'd originally thought. He could barely speak when I first met him."
中文译文: “不得不说，你的宠物比我预想中迷人得多。我第一次见到他时他几乎说不出话来。”

英文原文: "Erm...yes, he was shy."
中文译文: “呃...嗯，他之前很害羞。”

英文原文: I guess I should have told Amicus that my act had been exposed at this point.
中文译文: 我想我应该告诉Amicus，我的伪装已经暴露了。

英文原文: "Well, we must reconnect with this Simia, then. They seem oddly intelligent."
中文译文: “那么，我们应该重新和希米安沟通。他们似乎聪明得出奇。”

英文原文: "Mmh, yes...Oh, thank the gods for the trees. Vita is much too harsh today."
中文译文: “嗯，对...噢，感谢神赐予的树木。今天的维塔太猛烈了。”

英文原文: Amicus clearly tries to change the subject as the road turns into the thick forest.
中文译文: 在道路两旁变成了一片茂密的森林时，Amicus很明显地试图岔开话题。

英文原文: We're blanketed in an eerie, green glow as the forest envelops us.
中文译文: 森林环绕着我们，我们被一片怪异的绿色所笼罩。

英文原文: Strange, glowing insects fly around our carriage, and I notice how ancient the trees look, gnarled and rough, almost completely blocking out the sky.
中文译文: 奇怪的发光昆虫在我们车厢周围飞来飞去，外面的树木看起来那样古老，粗糙扭曲的枝节几乎完全遮蔽了天空。

英文原文: "Hopefully they allow us to freshen up a bit before the ceremony. I'll be a mess by the time we reach the city."
中文译文: “希望在仪式前，我们可以先梳洗一下。到城市以后我的样子一定会很狼狈。”

英文原文: Virginia whips out her large, embroidered fan again, waving it frantically in her face.
中文译文: Virginia甩开她巨大的，上面有刺绣的扇子，疯狂地对着脸扇起来。

英文原文: I kind of wish I had one too, my skin almost immediately sticky in the humid air.
中文译文: 我有点儿希望自己也能有一把，我的皮肤几乎立马就被潮湿的空气弄得粘乎乎的。

英文原文: "You will look fine. Besides, we'll all be in the same state."
中文译文: “你的样子不会有事的。况且，我们也是同样的状态。”

英文原文: Amicus glances over at the jackal.
中文译文: Amicus瞥了一眼胡狼。

英文原文: "I have to wonder what brought you along, Neferu?"
中文译文: “我很好奇你为什么也在，Neferu？”

英文原文: "My presence was requested."
中文译文: “我受邀出席。”

英文原文: "By whom?"
中文译文: “是谁？”

英文原文: "Oh, for the sake of Vita, don't start, Amicus."
中文译文: “哦，为了维塔，别这样，Amicus。”

英文原文: "What? I'm simply curious."
中文译文: “怎么了？我只是好奇。”

英文原文: "No, you're trying to start a fight, which is the last thing we need in front of the triumvirates"
中文译文: “不，你是在挑起一场争斗，这是我们最不需要在三人执政团面前表现出来的。”

英文原文: "Hmph..."
"Besides, isn't your policy to befriend Khemians?"
中文译文: “再说，你的政策不是要和克米扬做朋友吗？”

英文原文: "An alliance isn't a friendship."
中文译文: “联盟不是友谊。”

英文原文: "Khemians see it as friendship."
中文译文: “克米扬将其视作友谊。”

英文原文: "Besides, everyone probably thinks you're already very...close after what was broadcast."
中文译文: “此外，在那个节目以后，几乎所有人都认为你们已经相当...亲密了。”

英文原文: "Virginia!"
中文译文: “Virginia！”

英文原文: She hides her smirk behind the fan as Neferu grins beside her.
中文译文: 她把自己的笑容藏在扇子后面，而Neferu则在她旁边咧嘴笑着。

英文原文: "I'm simply reminding you that it might still be fresh in everyone's mind when we get there."
中文译文: “我只是想提醒你，对那里的人来说这个想法还很新鲜。”

英文原文: Amicus slumps in his seat, legs stretched out in front of him.
中文译文: Amicus瘫在了他的座位上，双腿伸在前面。

英文原文: "All the more reason to seem distant. That will probably affect my reputation for YEARS."
中文译文: “一个不友好的想法。这可能会影响我多年以来的声誉。”

英文原文: "Oh, don't be so dramatic. The people love such scandals, they simply pretend to be outraged."
中文译文: “噢，别这么夸张。人们喜欢这种丑闻，他们的愤怒是假装出来的。”

英文原文: Amicus snorts, but doesn't say anything more, signaling that the conversation is over.
中文译文: Amicus哼了一声，不过没有继续再说什么，表示这个话题已经结束了。

英文原文: I wonder if Cassius, sitting right behind us, is listening in.
中文译文: 我很好奇坐在我们身后的Cassius有没有在听。

英文原文: Probably.
中文译文: 或许吧。

英文原文: I find the whole thing strange, the wolf that tried to sabotage Amicus by leaking what was basically a porno sitting right behind us.
中文译文: 那个试图通过泄露，基本上是黄片的东西来阻碍Amicus的狼，就坐在我们后面，我感觉怪怪的。

英文原文: I turn my head ever so slightly, trying to look back at Cassius to see if he's looking at us.
中文译文: 我微微转过头，想知道Cassius是否在看着我们。

英文原文: I don't see anything, so I turn around more fully and find that the white wolf is laying down, eyes closed with his head in Alex's lap.
中文译文: 我什么也没看见，于是我完全转了过去，发现白狼正躺在那里。他闭着双眼，头枕在Alex的大腿上。

英文原文: Alex looks up at me and smiles with a wave.
中文译文: Alex抬头看见了我，微笑着挥手打了个招呼。

英文原文: I wave back awkwardly before quickly turning around.
中文译文: 我也尴尬地挥了挥手，然后迅速扭了回来。

英文原文: Virginia and Neferu seemed to be caught up in their own conversation at the moment while Amicus continues to sulk, staring at his feet.
中文译文: Virginia和Neferu似乎沉浸在他们的谈话中，而Amicus继续生着闷气，眼睛盯着他的脚。

英文原文: "So...what exactly is gonna happen when we get there?"
中文译文: “那么...我们到了以后，具体要怎么样？”

英文原文: "Hm? Oh, well, the meeting with the triumvirates, as I said earlier."
中文译文: “嗯？哦，这个吗，就像我之前说的，和三人执政团们会见。”

英文原文: "After that, we'll likely get to walk the streets of the district to visit the shops and a restaurant."
中文译文: “在那之后，我们可能会在附近的街道上走走，参观商店和餐馆。”

英文原文: "So I'll just stand next to you?"
中文译文: “所以我就站在你旁边就行？”

英文原文: "Yes."
中文译文: “是的。”

英文原文: "Alright."
For the rest of the ride, I lean against Amicus's side, and after several minutes I start to nod off.
中文译文: 接下来的路程中，我斜靠着Amicus，没过几分钟就开始打起了瞌睡。

英文原文: Amicus notices and wraps an arm around me, and I'm able to comfortably lean against his chest to fall asleep...
中文译文: Amicus注意到，并用一只胳膊搂住了我。就这样，我舒服地靠在他的胸前睡着了...

英文原文: The next thing I know, I'm being nudged awake by Amicus.
中文译文: 接下来我知道的就是，我被Amicus轻轻推醒了。

英文原文: I find myself staring at several buildings, the sudden change in scenery leaving me dazed.
中文译文: 我盯着几栋建筑物，景色的突然转换令我有些茫然。

英文原文: I'm still trying to get my bearings as Amicus hops out of the carriage, reaching up to lift me down.
中文译文: 我还在找方向感的时候，Amicus已经从车厢里跳了出去，伸爪把我扶下来。

英文原文: When I look back up, I'm able to see a large group of wolves off to the side, watching us intently.
中文译文: 我回头一看，侧面围着一大群狼，他们全神贯注地看着我们。

英文原文: Immediately I feel self-conscious, the crowd being the largest gathering of wolves that I've seen in person.
中文译文: 我立刻就感到了难为情，这群狼是我亲眼所见的，数量最多的一群了。

英文原文: They come in all shapes and sizes, and I'm surprised to see a few of them that are almost as short as I am.
中文译文: 他们形态各异，高矮不一，我很惊讶地看到他们中有一些与我一样矮。

英文原文: The one characteristic that all of them share though, is their thick-bodied stature.
中文译文: 不过，他们都有一个共同的特征，就是身体结实。

英文原文: Amicus guides me around to stand in front of the chariot with Neferu, Virginia, Cassius, and Alex, holding me close to his side.
中文译文: Amicus领着我，和Neferu、Virginia、Cassius还有Alex一起走到车前，他紧紧地将我搂在身边。

英文原文: One of the old wolves steps forward from the group.
中文译文: 一只老狼从狼群中走上前来。

英文原文: Triumvirate" ""Welcome imperial family! Thank you so much for coming on this day of the second trial. It was a marvelous show!"
中文译文: Triumvirate" "“欢迎皇室家族的到来！非常感谢今天的第二场选拔赛。真是一场精彩的演出！”

英文原文: That seems like a bold thing to say after a clip of Neferu and Amicus having sex was shown.
中文译文: 这似乎是个大胆的说法，在Amicus和Neferu做过的事被揭露了以后。

英文原文: There doesn't seem to be any awkwardness though, the old wolves looking eager to talk to Amicus.
中文译文: 不过，明面上没有任何的尴尬，那些老狼看起来很想和Amicus交谈。

英文原文: Triumvirate" ""I am Cicero, First Triumvirate of Ad Rotae."
中文译文: Triumvirate" "“我是Cicero，艾德.罗迪的第一位执政官。”

英文原文: The old wolf walks forward toward Amicus, setting his paws on the bigger wolf's shoulders and touching the sides of their muzzles together.
中文译文: 老狼朝着Amicus走了过去，把双爪放在大狼的肩上，他们互相碰了碰彼此的脸颊。

英文原文: Out of the corner of my eye, I notice Cassius shooting us a sour, angry look.
中文译文: 我用眼角的余光注意到Cassius向我们投来了酸溜溜的，愤怒的眼神。

英文原文: The wolf and Amicus hold a short conversation, the older wolf asking Amicus what he thought of Ad Rotae, what problems the city was currently having, and how they might proceed in the future.
中文译文: 狼和Amicus进行了一次简短的交谈，老狼询问了Amicus他对艾德.罗迪有什么样的看法、城市目前存在的一些问题，以及他们未来将如何发展。

英文原文: After that, he then he moves on to Virginia where the conversation is much shorter.
中文译文: 之后，他又去了Virginia那里，这次的谈话要短得多。

英文原文: Another wolf from the group moves forward to talk to Amicus, the conversation following a roughly similar pattern.
中文译文: 另一只狼从狼群里走上前去和Amicus交谈，谈话模式大致类似。

英文原文: There's no talk about Amicus being emperor, but the assumption is there, and when each of them gets to Cassius, it's almost as equally brief as it was with Virginia.
中文译文: 没有人说过Amicus会成为皇帝，但都是这么假设的。每个人和Cassius说话的时间，几乎和Virginia的一样短。

英文原文: Despite the novelty of this situation, I quickly become bored, and the conversations blend together very quickly as over a dozen of these old wolves come forward to introduce themselves to Amicus.
中文译文: 尽管这个状况很新奇，不过我很快就觉得无聊了。十来个老狼全都站出来向Amicus做自我介绍，对话很快就掺杂在了一起。

英文原文: For his part, Amicus does a really good job of seeming enthusiastic for each introduction, mentioning that he already knows who they are and that he thinks very, very highly of their city and region.
中文译文: 从他的角度来说，Amicus对每一次介绍都表现得十分热情，提到他已经知道了他们是谁，还有他对他们的城市和地区给予了非常，非常高的评价。

英文原文: Occasionally, they'll glance at me and comment on how strange I look, though it's usually with a positive tone, congratulating Amicus on snagging me.
中文译文: 他们偶尔会瞥我一眼，评价我的样子有多奇怪，尽管一般用的是积极的语气，祝贺Amicus捕获了我。

英文原文: That does seem to make Amicus uncomfortable, but I keep a straight face and bow each time, seeming to delight the old wolves with my etiquette.
中文译文: 这似乎令Amicus很不自在，不过我每次都会面无表情地鞠躬，表面上用我的礼仪来取悦那些老狼。

英文原文: Eventually, these introductions end, but as we start to move toward the shops, the triumvirates continue to follow us, and I find myself having a harder time keeping up with Amicus.
中文译文: 终于，介绍结束了。不过在我们向商店走去时，三人执政团们还在继续跟着我们，而且我发现自己很难保持在Amicus身边。

英文原文: He's practically surrounded by the triumvirates.
中文译文: 他几乎被三人执政团的狼给包围了。

英文原文: I give up on trying to stay next to him, and even though he keeps glancing at me and calls to me a few times, I just wave him on, choosing instead to walk alongside Neferu and Virginia.
中文译文: 尽管他不停地寻找着我，还呼唤了我几次，不过我已经放弃去他身边的尝试了。于是我朝他挥手示意了一下，选择走在Neferu和Virginia身边。

英文原文: Sure, it's annoying, but he's about to become emperor, so it makes sense that he's so popular.
中文译文: 他即将成为皇帝，所以这么受欢迎也说得通。当然了，这很烦人。

英文原文: As we walk through the streets, wolves call out to Amicus from doorways and windows, and he tries to wave at all of them.
中文译文: 我们走在街道上，狼们透过窗户和门口朝Amicus叫喊，而他试着朝所有狼挥手。

英文原文: Further up the road, a group of children...puppies show up with flowers in their paws, handing them out to Amicus and the triumvirates.
中文译文: 继续往前，出现了一群孩子...幼狼，他们爪子里拿着花，把它们递给Amicus和三人执政团们。

英文原文: As I watch this happening, I notice a particularly patchy-looking child, no taller than my waist standing off to the side awkwardly, looking right at me as she holds a flower in her paws.
中文译文: 在注视着这一切的时候，我留意到一个不及我腰高的，皮毛斑驳的孩子。她笨拙地站在一旁，看着我，爪子握着一朵花。

英文原文: I pause, unsure if she means to give it to me.
中文译文: 我停了下来，不确定她是不是打算把花给我。

英文原文: When I do, she moves closer.
中文译文: 就在我停下来的同时，她靠近了。

英文原文: So I bend over, reaching out and her eyes widen, probably simultaneously horrified and fascinated at getting the crazy alien's attention.
中文译文: 于是我弯下腰，伸出了手。她眼睛睁得大大的，可能是被吓到了，还有自己被这个疯狂的外星人注意到而陶醉着。

英文原文: Nevertheless, she comes closer and shyly pushes the crumpled, wilted flower into my hands before suddenly leaning in and touching the side of her face to mine.
中文译文: 尽管如此，她还是走近了我，羞怯地把那朵皱巴巴、枯萎了的花推到我手里，然后身子突然倾了过来，用她的脸颊碰了下我的。

英文原文: For a moment, I see her watery, bloodshot eyes.
中文译文: 在这短暂期间，我凝视着她水汪汪、布满血丝的双眼。

英文原文: Then I feel the slightly damp fur brush my skin before she makes an odd yelping sound and runs off down the street.
中文译文: 然后，我感到略微有些湿润的毛拂过了我的皮肤。再然后，她发出了一声奇怪的嚎叫，沿着街道跑远了。

英文原文: I stare after her, wondering if I'd done something wrong.
中文译文: 我盯着她的背影...不知道我是否做错了什么。

英文原文: "Found yourself a gift?"
中文译文: “收到了一份礼物？”

英文原文: I look down at the white flower, noticing that several petals are missing.
中文译文: 我低头看着白色的花，上面少了几片花瓣。

英文原文: "I guess."
中文译文: “我想是吧。”

英文原文: "That one didn't look healthy, did she?"
中文译文: “她看起来不太健康，是不是？”

英文原文: "Not really."
中文译文: “确实。”

英文原文: "Maybe Cassius had a point with his speech."
中文译文: “也许Cassius的演讲有一定道理。”

英文原文: "I think they both made good points, honestly."
中文译文: “说实话，我认为他们两个讲得都很好。”

英文原文: Neferu gestures at the gaggle of wolves moving further and further away from us.
中文译文: Neferu朝着离我们越来越远的吵闹狼群打了个手势。

英文原文: "Better catch up before they leave us behind."
中文译文: “在被甩掉之前，我们最好跟上他们。”

英文原文: "Yeah."
中文译文: “是啊。”

英文原文: I look down at the flower again, a bit uneasy now, before dropping it to the road, feeling a little guilty as I do.
中文译文: 我最后低头看了一眼那朵花，然后把它扔到了路上，心里感到一丝内疚。

英文原文: Even though the ceremony is technically over, the triumvirates don't seem to want to leave Amicus alone.
中文译文: 尽管严格意义上来说，仪式已经结束了，不过三人执政团们似乎并没有让Amicus独处的打算。

英文原文: I'm kind of amazed at how well Amicus is dealing with them considering how irritated I'm feeling.
中文译文: 我有些惊讶Amicus和他们相处得这么好，同时还有点恼火。

英文原文: Amicus tries to bring me over to his side a few times, pointing out trinkets and souvenirs that he tries to explain, as if wanting to show me a bit of Adastran culture.
中文译文: Amicus几次试图把我领到他身边，指着那些小饰品和纪念物，像是在试图展示一些阿达斯特拉的文化。

英文原文: It's nice, and I can tell he wants to involve me, but it's far too busy with triumvirates and locals breaking in every five seconds to ask or tell Amicus something.
中文译文: 我看得出来他不想冷落我，这很好。但是三人执政团们和当地狼每隔几秒钟就会硬挤进来，询问或是告诉Amicus一些事情。

英文原文: I wish he could just tell them to go away, but I know it doesn't work like that.
中文译文: 我很希望他会叫他们离开，不过想也知道这是不可能的。

英文原文: On top of this, my joints are really starting to ache from all the walking and I wonder if living in the palace for so long has made me soft.
中文译文: 除此以外，在走路时我的关节真的很疼，不知道皇宫里的生活是不是太安逸了。

英文原文: Eventually, I just trail the group of wolves, browsing the goods after they do.
中文译文: 在最后，我无精打采地跟在狼群后面，随便看着他们浏览过一遍的商品。

英文原文: It's interesting, sure, but everything's so similar to what we have on Earth: necklaces, earrings, brushes, clothes, nothing all that mind-blowing.
中文译文: 确实还算有趣，不过这些都和地球上的东西十分相似：项链、耳环、刷子、衣服，没有什么印象深刻的。

英文原文: Eventually, Amicus very loudly calls out that he'd like to go to a restaurant with his pet, if everyone could please allow him through.
中文译文: 终于，Amicus非常大声地喊道他想和他的宠物一起去餐馆，请大家让一下。

英文原文: I take this as my cue to move to his side and he immediately puts an arm around mine, holding me close.
中文译文: 我借此机会溜到了他身边，他立刻用一只胳膊紧紧搂住了我。

英文原文: As we walk up the street (the many wolves still following behind us) Amicus puts his muzzle close to my ear, sending a bit of a chill over my neck...one that's oddly painful.
中文译文: 我们沿街走着（后面还跟着很多狼），Amicus把嘴凑到我耳边，我的脖子因此感到一丝凉意...还有一种奇怪的疼痛。

英文原文: "Everything okay, [mc]? You seem a bit...uncomfortable."
中文译文: “一切还好吗，[mc]？你看起来有些...不太舒服。”

英文原文: I shrug.
中文译文: 我耸了耸肩。

英文原文: "Everything around here is new to me, so I guess I do feel a little bit off."
中文译文: “这里的一切对我来说都是陌生的，所以我想我确实有点儿不舒服。”

英文原文: "Well, let's settle down in a restaurant. We can cool off and catch our breath there."
中文译文: “嗯，我们在餐馆里歇歇脚，喘口气，冷静一下。”

英文原文: The wolf gives me a quick squeeze with his arm, and despite my slightly sour mood, I can't help but smile a bit.
中文译文: 狼飞快地用胳膊夹了我一下，虽然有些闷闷不乐，不过我还是忍不住笑了笑。

英文原文: I mean, it is kind of cool that my friend is so popular...even if it's because he's going to be the next emperor.
中文译文: 我想说，Amicus这么受欢迎还是蛮酷的...即便这是因为他将成为下一任皇帝。

英文原文: We walk into a small, but cozy restaurant, and I can tell right away that it's rather upscale with its carved pillars, and the fancy tapestries on the wall.
中文译文: 我们走进了一家小而舒适的餐馆。里面有带雕刻的柱子，墙上挂着精美的壁毯，我马上就能看出来这家餐馆相当高档。

英文原文: Then again, everything in this district is kind of upscale, I guess.
中文译文: 强调一下，我想这个地区的一切应该都是高档的。

英文原文: The triumvirates follow us right into the restaurant though, and I let out a frustrated sigh.
中文译文: 不过，三人执政团们还是跟着我们进了餐馆，我失望地叹了口气。

英文原文: Amicus notices right away and signals at a wolf standing behind a podium.
中文译文: Amicus立刻注意到了，并朝站在台子后面的狼示意了一下。

英文原文: This particular wolf is staring at us wide-eyed, apparently gob smacked at seeing the soon-to-be emperor show up in his restaurant.
中文译文: 这只狼盯着我们，眼睛瞪得大大的，显然是因为未来的皇帝出现在他的餐馆里而惊呆了。

英文原文: He practically trips over himself to get to us, banging his hip on the side of a table as he does.
中文译文: 他磕磕绊绊地跑到我们旁边，屁股还撞到了桌子。

英文原文: Wolf" ""Y-y-y-yes, your, uh, your....uh, majesty?"
中文译文: Wolf" "“是-是-是-是的，您，呃，您....呃，陛下？”

英文原文: Amicus grimaces.
中文译文: Amicus做了个鬼脸。

英文原文: "Just Amicus, please. Could you get us a secluded table, preferably with no one seated next to us."
中文译文: “称呼Amicus就可以了，谢谢。你能给我们找张安静的桌子吗？最好周围不要坐人。”

英文原文: "Of course!"
中文译文: “当然！”

英文原文: The wolf stumbles over himself again before leading us to a corner of the restaurant, gesturing at a table there.
中文译文: 那只狼又绊了自己一跤，然后把我们带到餐馆的一个角落，示意了一下那里的一张桌子。

英文原文: He then turns to a couple next to the table and begins to frantically hiss at them to move.
中文译文: 接着他转向了旁边的一对夫妇，开始疯狂地赶他们离开。

英文原文: They stare at him in astonishment until Amicus steps in to stop him.
中文译文: 他们一脸惊讶地看着他，直到Amicus出面阻止。

英文原文: "They're fine, just uh, don't let any of...that group over there sit next to us, if that's alright?"
中文译文: “他们没事的，只要，呃，别让...那边那一群坐在我们旁边，可以吗？”

英文原文: Amicus jerks his head over at the gaggle of old wolves, all of them staring at us rather hawkishly.
中文译文: Amicus迅速地看了一眼那群吵闹的老狼，他们全都很强硬地盯着我们。

英文原文: "Oh, yes, of course!"
中文译文: “噢，是的，当然！”

英文原文: He hurries off toward said group and we're finally able to sit down...or lay down.
中文译文: 他匆匆朝那群狼走去，我们终于可以坐下...或是躺下了。

英文原文: The seats are of course in the Roman style.
中文译文: 座位当然是罗马式的。

英文原文: Amicus settles down with a huge sigh, stretching his big body over the bed.
中文译文: Amicus长叹一声，躺了下来，庞大的身体在床上伸了个懒腰。

英文原文: "Sorry about that. I should have warned you about how...frustrating it can be with all the pointless chatter."
中文译文: “真抱歉。我应该预先提醒你一下...那些毫无意义的唠叨有多无聊。”

英文原文: I shrug.
中文译文: 我耸了耸肩。

英文原文: "Seems about right for politics."
中文译文: “权术似乎都这个样。”

英文原文: "Oh, it is, but don't worry, it's rare that all the triumvirates are in the city all at once. This is for the trials, of course."
中文译文: “噢，没错，不过别担心，所有三人执政团出现在一座城里是很罕见的。当然，这次是为了选拔。”

英文原文: "Yeah, makes sense."
中文译文: “是啊，确实。”

英文原文: "You sure you're okay? I can never seem to tell."
中文译文: “你确定你没事吗？我总觉得...我说不出来。”

英文原文: "I'm fine."
中文译文: “我很好。”

英文原文: I rub my arms, the skin sensitive and sore, just like my joints.
中文译文: 我揉搓着双臂，上面的皮肤敏感而酸痛，就像我的关节一样。

英文原文: I wonder if I'm getting sunburned too.
中文译文: 不知道我是不是被晒伤了。

英文原文: "Alright...so what do you think of the city? This part of it at least. I wish I could take you to where the skyscrapers are, but as I said, things are a bit chaotic at the moment."
中文译文: “好吧...那么，你觉得这个城市怎么样？就这一部分地区来说。我也希望能带你去参观高楼大厦，但我说过，目前的情况有些混乱。”

英文原文: "It's pretty cool. It wouldn't exactly be out of place on Earth, definitely different, but really similar."
中文译文: “挺酷的。它和地球上有很大区别，不过又十分相似。”

英文原文: "Ah, well, you were uplifted by us after all."
中文译文: “哈，毕竟你们被我们培养过。”

英文原文: "...Yeah. So is this what you're gonna do as emperor? Come to the city and just...talk?"
中文译文: “...是啊。所以这就是你成为皇帝后要做的？到城里...谈个话就行？”

英文原文: Amicus chuckles.
中文译文: Amicus轻声笑了。

英文原文: "Oh, there will be much more to it, I'm sure. I'm hoping Cato will teach me a bit...if he's able to get over the trial."
中文译文: “喔，肯定不止这些。希望Cato能教我一下...如果他能放下选拔的事的话。”

英文原文: I remember that Cato did vote for Cassius.
中文译文: 我记得Cato把票投给了Cassius。

英文原文: He's probably furious about it right now.
中文译文: 也许他正在为此而感到愤怒。

英文原文: "Won't you have like, advisors and stuff?"
中文译文: “你今后就没有，顾问之类的人吗？”

英文原文: "Well, yes, but I must choose them."
中文译文: “唔，有啊，不过必须由我来选择。”

英文原文: "Would you choose Cato?"
中文译文: “你要选择Cato？”

英文原文: "I could."
中文译文: “也可以。”

英文原文: "Will you?"
中文译文: “你会吗？”

英文原文: "Well...maybe, but recent events have left me a bit unsure of that."
中文译文: “这个...也许吧，但是最近发生的事令我不太确定。”

英文原文: "Why's that?"
中文译文: “为什么？”

英文原文: Amicus shakes his head.
中文译文: Amicus摇了摇头。

英文原文: "Don't worry about it now, we should be celebrating."
中文译文: “这个时候就别担心了，我们应该庆祝才对。”

英文原文: "I mean, you could become emperor at any moment. Shouldn't you have someone who's got a good head on their shoulders at the ready?"
中文译文: “我说，你随时都有可能成为皇帝。难道你不该提前在手边准备好一个头脑清醒的人吗？”

英文原文: "Heh, I suppose. Who would you suggest?"
中文译文: “哈，我想也是。你有什么人选么？”

英文原文: I get the feeling that he's goading me to offer myself, but that definitely wouldn't be the case.
中文译文: 我有种他在怂恿我毛遂自荐的感觉，但这是不可能的。

英文原文: The few wolves I know makes the decision pretty easy.
中文译文: 我轻易地就从少数认识的人中做出了选择。

英文原文: "Virginia."
中文译文: “Virginia。”

英文原文: Amicus raises his eyebrows in slight surprise.
中文译文: Amicus略微惊讶地扬起眉毛。

英文原文: "Oh...well, yes, I would definitely consider her. The only problem is the image of a female telling me what do do. The tail-raiser reputation is bad enough."
中文译文: “哦...是吗，好，我会明确考虑她的。唯一的问题是听从一名雌性的建议不太好看，翘尾巴的名声已经够坏的了。”

英文原文: I roll my eyes.
中文译文: 我翻了个白眼。

英文原文: "Maybe wolven masculinity is something you can fix while you're emperor?"
中文译文: “也许你应该在成为皇帝以后修正一下沃尔文的大男子主义？”

英文原文: Amicus doesn't seem to know how to answer that, but he doesn't have to as our food arrives.
中文译文: Amicus似乎不知该如何回答，好在这时我们的食物到了。

英文原文: I'm a bit surprised since we didn't order, but looking around, it seems that everyone gets the same thing.
中文译文: 我有点儿惊讶，因为我们还没有点菜。不过我环顾四周，发现每一桌都上了同样的东西。

英文原文: There's the usual olives, grapes, cheese, and bread, but also seafood, and even eggs which surprises me.
中文译文: 有平常吃的橄榄、葡萄、奶酪和面包，令我感到意外的是甚至还有海鲜和鸡蛋。

英文原文: Amicus thanks the nervous waiter before immediately starting to dig in.
中文译文: Amicus先是感谢了那个侍者，然后迫不及待地开始动爪。

英文原文: I do the same, but while I'm spreading cheese onto the bread, my mind wanders back to what might be happening in the city right now.
中文译文: 我也做了同样的事，不过在面包上抹奶酪的时候，我的思绪又回到了这座城市可能正发生的事情上。

英文原文: "So...how bad are things in the city? No one seems that concerned about it."
中文译文: “那么...这座城市的情况有多糟？好像没人特别在意过。”

英文原文: "From what I've been told, it's fairly mild. Riots are common in Adastra, but they don't last long. I think the people will calm down within the next few days."
中文译文: “据我所知，这里相当温和了。阿达斯特拉经常出现骚乱，但都不会持续太久。我想我想未来几天人们会平静下来的。”

英文原文: "Oh, okay. So they don't like...dislike you, or anything?"
中文译文: “噢，这样啊。所以他们是...不喜欢你，还是因为什么？”

英文原文: It takes Amicus a moment to swallow down his mouthful of bread before speaking.
中文译文: Amicus花了点儿时间咽下满嘴的面包，然后才开始说。

英文原文: "No, no, most of the anger is directed at the triumvirates. I will say though, I have my work cut out in rebuilding my reputation."
中文译文: “不，不，大部分的怒火都是针对三人执政团的。不过，在重新恢复我的声誉方面，我还有很多工作要做。”

英文原文: "Because of the sex video?"
中文译文: “因为那个性爱录像？”

英文原文: "Heh...yes."
中文译文: “呵呵...是的。”

英文原文: Amicus tries to smile it off light-heartedly, but I can see his ears turning red.
中文译文: Amicus试图笑得自然一些，但我看得到他的耳朵变红了。

英文原文: It must be weird being out in public like this, knowing that everyone saw it.
中文译文: 在这样的公共场合露面一定很奇怪，得知所有人都看过那种东西以后。

英文原文: "I was told by one of the triumvirates from Lux to simply say it was fake...not sure if that will work."
中文译文: “一个来自卢克斯的执政官告诉我，可以直接宣称它是伪造的...不确定行不行得通。”

英文原文: "Could be a good idea."
中文译文: “或许是个好主意。”

英文原文: "Really, the biggest issue is that it delegitimizes the alliance process with the Khemians. The people will believe that I'm beholden to Neferu somehow."
中文译文: “说实在的，最大的问题其实在于，它使和克米扬的结盟失去了合理性。人们会认为我是受了Neferu的某种恩惠。”

英文原文: Amicus's expression finally falls a bit, staring down at the food as his munching slows down.
中文译文: Amicus露出了有些失落的表情，他盯着那些食物，咀嚼的速度慢了下来。

英文原文: "I'm sure they'll get over it. From what I've been told, it seems like they're quick to forget."
中文译文: “我相信他们会过去的。有人告诉过我，他们应该很快就会忘记。”

英文原文: "Well yes, as soon as the next scandal comes along, hopefully one not involving me."
中文译文: “嗯，直到下一个丑闻出现的时候，希望那个与我无关。”

英文原文: "Yeah."
中文译文: “是啊。”

英文原文: We eat in silence a while, and I can tell something heavy is on Amicus's mind.
中文译文: 我们沉默地吃了一会儿，我很肯定有什么重要的事正萦绕在Amicus心头。

英文原文: In the meantime, I'm a bit distracted with itching specific spots on my arms, feeling tiny little bumps on the skin.
中文译文: 与此同时，我因为手臂上发痒的丘疹而有些心不在焉，感觉皮肤上起了一些小小的疙瘩。

英文原文: I wonder if I'm allergic to something in the meal, so I stop eating for the moment, choosing instead to lounge out on the bed.
中文译文: 不知道我是不是对某样食物过敏了，于是我停止了进食，选择躺在床上休息。

英文原文: "[mc], I've been meaning to ask you something."
中文译文: “[mc]，我一直想问你一件事。”

英文原文: "Yeah?"
中文译文: “问吧？”

英文原文: "Do you...do you want to stay here, even after I become emperor?"
中文译文: “你愿意...愿意留在这里吗，即使在我成为皇帝以后？”

英文原文: The question catches me by surprise, and I'm left to try and gather my thoughts for a moment as Amicus continues to look down.
中文译文: 这个问题令我大吃一惊，我试着在Amicus低头往下看时整理一下思绪。

英文原文: "Um, what do you mean?"
中文译文: “呃，这是什么意思？”

英文原文: Amicus sighs and glances at me.
中文译文: Amicus叹了口气，偷偷看了我一眼。

英文原文: "I mean, do you want to stay here with me, even if you have the ability to go home."
中文译文: “我的意思是，就算你能够回家了，你愿意留下和我在一起吗。”

英文原文: Amicus quickly looks down again.
中文译文: Amicus再次迅速地低下了头。

英文原文: "I'm sorry, I know it's not my place to ask, but...I thought I might as well ask."
中文译文: “对不起，我知道我没有这么问的资格，不过...我想问一下应该无妨吧。”

英文原文: I stare at him for a moment, then I look down too.
中文译文: 我盯着他看了好一会儿，然后也低下了头。

英文原文: "You know I need to go back. At the very least I need to let my friends and family know that I'm okay. I know that they're looking for me in Italy right now...probably all of Europe at this point. I need to let them know."
中文译文: “我要回去，你知道的。至少我要让朋友和家人们知道我没事。我想现在，他们应该在意大利...甚至是整个欧洲找我。我必须让他们知道。”

英文原文: Amicus coughs hastily.
中文译文: Amicus急促地咳嗽了起来。

英文原文: "Of course."
中文译文: “当然了。”

英文原文: "But...that doesn't mean that I don't want to come back. I do. I just know that it's....that there are problems."
中文译文: “但是...这并不意味着我不想回来。我愿意。不过我知道...其中还有一些问题。”

英文原文: I lower my voice as I remember that we're in a public place and that mentioning illegal First Contact would not be a good idea.
中文译文: 我把声音压低，因为我想起来我们还在公共场所，在这儿提及非法的第一次接触可不是什么好主意。

英文原文: "If we can fix the problems, honestly...I'd love to come back and stay for a long time."
中文译文: “如果我们能解决这些问题，说真的...我非常愿意回来，而且再待很长时间。”

英文原文: I kind of surprise myself with that statement, but it's true.
中文译文: 我对自己的表态有些意外，但那是真心话。

英文原文: Amicus glances at me in surprise.
中文译文: Amicus惊讶地瞄了我一眼。

英文原文: "Really?"
中文译文: “真的吗？”

英文原文: "Yeah, if it wasn't a risk to your empire."
中文译文: “真的，如果这不会给你的帝国带来风险的话。”

英文原文: "Of course. I mean to speak to the parents as soon as I'm able. I'm sure...I'm certain we can figure something out."
中文译文: “当然不了。一旦条件允许，我会尽快和Parent们交谈。我相信...我肯定我们会解决的。”

英文原文: The look on Amicus's face right now, so sad, but a little hopeful, reminds me of something that I've been wanting to do for the past week.
中文译文: 此时此刻，Amicus脸上的表情，是如此悲伤，但还有着一丝希望。这使我想起了过去一周来我一直想做的一件事。

英文原文: "And Amicus?"
中文译文: “还有，Amicus？”

英文原文: "Yeah?"
I glance around quickly, making sure that the nearby patrons aren't listening.
中文译文: 我飞快环顾了一下四周，确保附近的顾客没有在听。

英文原文: "Do you want to date me?"
中文译文: “你愿意和我约会吗？”

英文原文: The statement, so ridiculous, so silly in this situation, comes out all quiet and weak, but I don't know how else to ask it.
中文译文: 我的声音安静而无力，在这种情况下，这个说法显得太荒唐、太愚蠢了，但我不知道除此之外还能怎么说。

英文原文: That word is so complicated between us now with how I tried to explain it to Amicus.
中文译文: 在我向Amicus那样解释后，这个词对于我们来说已经太过复杂了。

英文原文: It's something that I don't think I've ever said to anyone before, and just like Amicus, I find myself looking down immediately.
中文译文: 这样的话，我之前从未对任何人说过。我发现自己立即垂下了头，就像Amicus一样。

英文原文: It's quiet for a moment, and the restaurant suddenly lights up with a golden hue as the sunset hits the windows just right.
中文译文: 晚霞映照在窗户上，餐馆突然间被一股金色光芒所笼罩。安静的时光持续了一段时间。

英文原文: I hear a long exhalation and realize that the wolf had been holding his breath.
中文译文: 我听到了长长的呼气声，意识到狼一直在屏着呼吸。

英文原文: I look up then, and see Amicus smiling at me.
中文译文: 于是我抬起头，看到的是Amicus的微笑。

英文原文: There's a mixture of happiness and relief on his face, maybe even a little amusement.
中文译文: 他的神情混合着幸福和解脱，也许还有一点可笑。

英文原文: I guess we've been dancing around it for so long, we both knew by now that it's what we wanted, what we've been building up to.
中文译文: 我想，我们已经回避了太久了。现在，我们都已知晓：我们渴求的是什么，我们不断为之努力的是什么。

英文原文: "Of course, [mc]. I'm honored that you'd have me."
中文译文: “当然愿意，[mc]。我很荣幸你邀请了我。”

英文原文: I even see his eyes glistening a bit, and I want to get up right there and then and join him on his bed, but public setting holds me back.
中文译文: 我甚至看到他的眼睛闪烁着微光，我真想马上起身，和他在床上相拥，但是我们还在公共场所。

英文原文: I imagine Amicus is feeling the same way, and I wonder if maybe asking here in public wasn't the best place for it.
中文译文: 我猜Amicus也是同样的感觉，也许这里不是最适合邀请的地方。

英文原文: But it was done, and I feel myself grinning despite myself.
中文译文: 不过事情已经发生了，我不由自主地笑了出来。

英文原文: The wolf grins right back.
中文译文: 狼同样咧开嘴笑了。

英文原文: "Like you said, while I'm here we might as well get to know each other better...and if you DO figure something out, I can come back."
